# Whole G3 attempt: exact recognition through well-structured source reachability

Contributor: dot (OpenAI), 9 October 2026, 05:35 UTC.

Status: **failed whole-recognition route, with a source-faithful antichain theorem for hand review**. General G3 remains open. No publication is requested or performed by this packet. Historical novelty is unassessed.

## 1. Original endpoint and inherited frontier

The original finite-input G3 asks for a terminating decision and, on YES, extraction of ONE finite strictly positive admitted source realizing the entire rational/effectively algebraic input. The source class is finite binary rooted-LSA, outer-labelled planar cut-child galled networks, including parallel arc occurrences. Positive finite population lengths, interior natural inheritance, original root completion, one graph/ID map, one physical parameter tuple, finite supplied ties, original controls and any persistent shared registers must all survive. Every supplied topology/forest/coarsened-response row is evaluated from that SAME source. COMMON, INDEPENDENT and paired BOTH contracts are kept distinct. There is no supplied bound on hidden source size.

The original criterion [S1] gives strict graph-by-graph positive semidecision and an exact compact-budget characterization. The source-faithful reduction [S2], with accepted review [S3], reduces a fixed input to a finite protected-core catalogue. For each core its state q=(theta,K) retains every complete capped kernel and shared conditional/joint component; Init, Trans and the WHOLE terminal fibre F(q)=y are semialgebraic. Every finite legal path reconstructs an actual strict source, and every admitted source supplies such a path. The number of appends is unbounded.

The reviewed bounded-monotone-time attempt [S4,S5] supplies a finite current-forest poset and its invertible principal-upper-set zeta coordinates X(K). Every actual append has X(K') >= X(K), and each coordinate stays in [0,1]. Its rectangular-hybrid transfer failed because the physical rates/resets remain coupled and nonlinear. Its actual all-core relaxation counterexample and fixed-front-end limitations remain credited; they are not reproved here.

The present attempt uses a different termination theorem: well-structured transition systems and finite-basis saturation, rather than rectangular-time contraction, a source-size cap, or exact finite bisimulation. A failure of one of those older methods alone would not refute this route.

## 2. The proposed complete algorithm and its obligations

For each inherited protected core, seek an effective quasi-order on exact source states, compatible with legal physical appends. Use a well-quasi-order to terminate a symbolic saturation, retaining the full fibre F(q)=y. If that fibre can be handled as an upward target with effective predecessor bases, standard coverability machinery would decide its reachability. A finite accepting path would then be extracted and converted to the original source using [S2]. Return NO only after every protected-core alternative is excluded.

This plan has four distinct obligations:

1. A well-quasi-order on the relevant state space, not merely monotonicity along each path.
2. The required transition compatibility under that order.
3. An exact whole-fibre target treatment: coverability must not replace equality by an upward relaxation.
4. Effective symbolic predecessor/successor operations in the theorem's actual representation, retaining one physical tuple and all joint registers.

The natural candidate is coordinatewise order on the full zeta vector X. Its elementary path monotonicity is already established in [S4]. Sections 3–5 show that it has an infinite antichain of actual immediate successors of ONE fixed positive seed. This falsifies obligation 1 even with fixed shape, rational parameters, and a uniform positive parameter margin. Section 6 additionally rules out a uniform all-input exact-fibre upward-target repair by changing the quasi-order. No undecidability result follows.

## 3. A three-root forest identity

Start with three distinct opaque current roots labelled 1,2,3 in a private source slot. Consider any label-exchangeable, sampling-consistent merger-only slot kernel from the original natural source rules. Write:

- p: probability that two specified sampled roots remain separate at the exit;
- q: probability that all three roots remain separate;
- r: probability that exactly one merger has occurred;
- s: probability that all three have coalesced.

By pair projectivity, a fixed pair is separate on the q event and in two thirds of the one-merger cases. Therefore

    p = q + (2/3) r,
    r = (3/2)(p-q),
    s = 1 - (3/2)p + (1/2)q.                       (1)

Exchangeability makes the three possible one-merger forests equiprobable, each with probability r/3. It also makes the three complete rooted trees equiprobable, each with probability s/3. This statement uses actual opaque-root routing/projectivity. It does not treat a merged root as several new independent routing coins.

Let f12 denote the forest with roots (12) and 3. Let t12 denote the complete rooted tree ((12),3). In the merger partial order, the principal upper set of f12 contains precisely f12 and t12; t12 is maximal. Thus two entries of the SAME full zeta vector are

    U = P(upward(f12)) = (r+s)/3 = (1-q)/3,
    V = P(upward(t12)) = s/3 = 1/3 - p/2 + q/6.    (2)

At fixed p, increasing q strictly DECREASES U and strictly INCREASES V. Hence two such kernels with distinct q are incomparable in coordinatewise X order. They are also incomparable in the stronger stochastic order requiring inequality for every upward forest event. This is a full-kernel obstruction witnessed by two genuine principal coordinates, not a diagonal-only substitute for the kernel.

## 4. One strict bigon gives the infinite antichain in BOTH physical modes

Fix the leading ordinary seed E(z), z=3/4. Append one actual private bigon and one positive connector:

    K_mode(d) = E(3/4) B_mode(x,y,g) E(3/4),
    x=1/2-d, y=1/2+d, g=1/2, 0<d<1/4.             (3)

This is exactly one allowed append of [S2], from the SAME initialization. Set c=(3/4)^2=9/16. Every survival/inheritance parameter lies in [1/4,3/4], strictly inside the natural domain (0,1). The graph shape, cell count, initial state and connector are fixed. The family does not rely on parameters approaching an excluded endpoint. A sequence d_n=1/(n+5), n>=1, is rational and gives distinct parameters.

### COMMON

One shared coin routes the entire entering forest down one arm. Ordinary semigroup composition gives

    p_C = c (x+y)/2 = 9/32,
    q_C = c^3 (x^3+y^3)/2
        = c^3 (1/8 + (3/2)d^2).                   (4)

Equivalently, the full kernel in this one-cell case is the ACTUAL common-coin mixture of E(cx) and E(cy). This equality is derived from an admitted source; it is not a permission to add arbitrary external mixtures to the source class.

### INDEPENDENT

Each CURRENT root draws one independent fair arm coin. For two roots, same-arm routes have probabilities 1/4 each and different-arm routes probability 1/2. For three roots, the all-left/all-right routes have probability 1/8 each, and the two-plus-one assignments contribute 3x/8 and 3y/8 to the no-merger event. Consequently

    p_I = c ((x+y)/4 + 1/2) = 27/64,
    q_I = c^3 ((x^3+y^3)/8 + 3(x+y)/8)
        = c^3 (13/32 + (3/8)d^2).                 (5)

The leading and final ordinary intervals multiply the no-merger factors by z^lambda and a^lambda, respectively. Formula (5) calculates only the event of no merger, so it never routes the descendants of a merged root incorrectly. Identity (1), inherited source projectivity and exchangeability then recover the relevant complete forest probabilities.

For either mode, p is constant and q increases strictly with d. By (2), any two distinct K_mode(d_n) have their U and V coordinates in opposite orders. They are incomparable. Thus the full source-state order has an infinite antichain, even restricted to the reachable states at exactly one append from a fixed seed.

The same conclusion holds for a paired BOTH carrier generated using the SAME d and tuple in both components: a component projection already witnesses incomparability. This is not an assertion that COMMON and INDEPENDENT kernels coincide; their fixed pair survivals differ as (4) and (5) show. If a larger capped carrier contains this three-root block, coordinate projection transfers the obstruction to that entire carrier. Additional retained slots or static parameters can be held fixed. No extra observed root, taxon or register has been introduced.

## 5. Precise finite-basis consequences and what they do not say

Let A={X(K_mode(d_n)):n>=1}. In the componentwise partial order, its upward closure has no finite basis, even if basis points may be arbitrary members of that upward closure.

Indeed, suppose a finite B contained in upward(A) generated upward(A). For each a in A, choose b in B with b<=a. Since b is in upward(A), some a' in A satisfies a'<=b. Then a'<=a. Antichainness forces a'=a, and antisymmetry forces b=a. Thus B must contain every member of A, a contradiction.

This is a statement about the upward closure of the specified legal successor SUBFAMILY A. It does NOT assert that the upward closure of the unrestricted complete successor set has no finite basis: additional legal successors could dominate members of A from below. The directly applicable conclusion is that the state order itself is not a well-quasi-order, including when restricted to states reachable from the fixed seed. Therefore the generic wqo stabilization proof cannot be invoked.

Any refinement of the order that still requires both U and V to be nondecreasing on comparable pairs inherits the same antichain. Reversing both coordinate inequalities also leaves it an antichain. Adding more faithful state coordinates cannot remove it. Keeping a positive parameter slab, fixing pair survival, or restricting to rational parameters does not remove it either.

This does not exclude an input-dependent symbolic representation of the entire semialgebraic curve, nor prove that all source-state orders fail. A finite formula can represent infinitely many incomparable concrete states. Proving termination of iterations of such formula regions needs a NEW argument; the wqo finite-point-basis theorem does not supply one. No original source-length lower bound is deduced: every example here has one bigon.

## 6. Whole-terminal-fibre equality is a second independent obligation

There is a simple general limitation on any uniform order that tries to make EVERY exact original observation fibre upward-closed.

**Lemma.** Let F:S->Y be a readout map. If every fibre F^{-1}(y), for y in a set Y0, is upward-closed under a quasi-order <=, then any comparable states s<=t with F(s) in Y0 satisfy F(s)=F(t). If F attains infinitely many distinct values in Y0, choosing one state per value gives an infinite antichain. Such an order is not a wqo.

Proof: t lies above s in the upward fibre of F(s), so F(t)=F(s). Distinct fibre representatives are consequently incomparable in either direction.

This is a statement about one uniform order handling all exact inputs. It does not forbid different orders for different y, or a reachability algorithm not based on upward targets.

The infinite-image premise is realized by an ORIGINAL finite observation experiment, without asking to observe the private kernel. Insert (3) on the A-pendant bridge of a fixed positive four-taxon tree ((A,B),(C,D)); fix every exterior population and the B-pendant survival, for example at 1/2. Use three A copies and one each of B,C,D. Read A-monophyly after the allowed rooted-topology restriction to A and B. The ordinary ancestral completion gives probability 1 on the s event, 1/3 on the r event and 1/6 on the q event. Hence

    P_A,3 = s + r/3 + q/6 = 1-p+q/6.              (6)

The two-A analogue is P_A,2=1-(2/3)p. These are the inherited monophyly formulas displayed in [S6]; equation (6) is also derived directly from the three-root decomposition here. The fixed-pair one-bigon family therefore has distinct rational P_A,3 values. The experiment can retain its ENTIRE final rooted-topology law; different P_A,3, which is a sum of those coordinates, forces different full-law profiles. Every full profile is rational by the original polynomial compiler, since all survival and inheritance coordinates are rational.

Thus for this fixed original finite experiment, no single order on exact source states can be both a wqo and make all its rational full-law fibres upward-closed. This is a uniform exact-target interface obstruction, not a G3 undecidability theorem. It does not assume all competing cores equal the displayed tree, and does not classify any profile as NO: the displayed sources suffice to contradict the proposed uniform order on a subfamily of admitted states.

For the actual general G3 algorithm, target-dependent orders or a more sophisticated exact target construction remain possible. Each would require a terminating effective construction and all-core correctness, not an appeal to the inherited monotone coordinates alone.

## 7. Primary theorem applicability and nearby extensions

Finkel and Schnoebelen's *Well-structured transition systems everywhere!* [L1], Definition 2.1/2.5 and Theorem 3.6, distinguish a well-quasi-order, compatible transitions, an effective predecessor basis and decidable comparison. Their algorithm decides coverability through upward targets. The source order above fails the first condition; whole-fibre equality also needs a separate exact translation. Their finitely branching tree-saturation presentation does not directly apply to the continuum of physical parameter choices. Semialgebraic relations can encode that branching, but that observation is not a termination proof.

Blondin, Finkel and McKenzie's *Well Behaved Transition Systems* [L2] relaxes well-foundedness while retaining absence of infinite antichains. The actual antichain here prevents invoking that relaxation with this same order. No generic undecidability statement in that paper is transferred to the biological source.

Bollig, Finkel and Suresh's *Branch-Well-Structured Transition Systems and Extensions* [L3] studies branch-restricted conditions. The inherited append order already compares successive states along each physical path. That branch fact does not remove the transverse family in (3), supply finite symbolic branching, or make an exact whole profile an upward target. No source-specific application of their stronger hypotheses is proved here.

The present application is elementary and is not represented as a new general WSTS theorem. The prior source compiler, projectivity, COMMON/INDEPENDENT rules, monophyly transforms, zeta representation and classical order theory are all reused.

## 8. Terminal result and remaining original obligation

This complete-recognition attempt cannot obtain a terminating algorithm by applying a wqo/no-infinite-antichain finite-basis theorem to the existing monotone kernel coordinates. The obstruction already occurs among uniformly interior, fixed-size, one-step physical sources in each original inheritance mode. A uniform change of order that makes every exact rational whole-observation fibre upward-closed also fails on an actual original finite experiment.

No answer has been obtained for arbitrary G3 input, no new source-admission relaxation has been accepted, and no original NO has been declared from a failed sufficient condition. The remaining task is still a source-exact, input-effective finite witness/exclusion mechanism across the whole terminal fibre and every protected core. General symbolic-region acceleration or target-specific order synthesis would have to discharge that task independently.

## 9. Evidence and source pins

This is a hand derivation awaiting independent review. A small original Python rational-arithmetic check was actually executed: 32 d values per mechanism, direct enumeration of two-/three-root INDEPENDENT coin assignments, normalization of all seven three-root forest probabilities, equality to (4)/(5), and 496 pairwise sign controls per mechanism. All passed. The infinite-family theorem is proved algebraically above; a finite check alone does not establish it.

`check_antichain.py` and `CHECK-OUTPUT.txt` preserve the actual executed source and output. No source inverse, graph catalogue, QE, simulation, scientific producer, compiler, Lean build or full source-kernel implementation ran. The helper computes the explicitly derived three-root formulas, not an independently implemented entire original forward engine. No remote state was changed.

### Repository sources actually read

- [S0: Canonical scope at 61b5f912](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/61b5f912e1d237c8c3fe90628b20604c2fcdbe5c/research/2026-10-07-dot-full-scope-reconciliation-1003z/CURRENT-SCOPE.md): full bytes retrieved; G3/relevant frontier sections selected for substantive reading.

# Whole G3 attempt: exact positive-flow duality and failure of automatic finite moment termination

Contributor: dot (OpenAI), 9 October 2026. Restart assignment at 13:49 UTC.
Status: complete hand argument for an exact reformulation and a specific failed full-recognizer implication; independent review pending. General original G3 remains open. No undecidability or exponential-separator incompleteness is claimed.

## 1. Proposed full recognizer, and its decisive implication

The attempted architecture is:

1. Compile the COMPLETE original finite algebraic input into the finite disjoint union of its protected core state spaces.
2. Replace finite legal paths by a positive finite-measure flow problem on the ACTUAL strict append relation, with initial mass in initialization and terminal mass in the WHOLE original target fibre.
3. Search finite polynomial moment/positivity certificates of infeasibility. In parallel enumerate actual finite source witnesses.
4. Claim termination if every infeasible exact flow problem has a finite moment-level infeasibility certificate.

Step 2 is an inherited exact equivalence, including minimum append count [S5], not a new result of this restart. Step 4 is false for the raw finite-polynomial-balance hierarchy specified here: Section 5 gives an original rational all-core NO on which EVERY finite polynomial balance level has an exact positive atomic feasible solution using legal strict source edges. This is a source-level failure of this particular full decision architecture, not merely failure of a literature hypothesis or a numerical convergence warning.

Section 6 also proves that allowing arbitrary finite semialgebraic test functions gives EXACTLY the existing semialgebraic inductive-separator language, by finite lexicographic cone separation. It does not supply separator existence.

The example is an elementary strict-boundary NO and is independently easy to reject. Adding the valid strict positive-diagonal and nonnegative normalized forest-carrier invariants removes this example. Thus the result does NOT exclude invariant-strengthened moment methods, finite exponential certificates, or a general recognizer. No theorem here says that all NO inputs fail the hierarchy.

## 2. Original quantifiers and exact state

The master [S1] asks whether ONE finite strictly positive admitted source fits ALL supplied rational/effectively real-algebraic response rows, with one graph, original IDs, physical assignment, programs, controls, registers and ties. Preserve the rooted-LSA, binary outer-labelled planar, cut-child galled grammar, parallel arcs and unbounded ancestral completion. COMMON, INDEPENDENT and BOTH retain their declared interfaces. No additional controls, repeated-position ties, signed physical factors or limiting sources are admitted.

At [S2], the accepted source reduction [S3] gives finitely many cores c, each with state q=(theta,K), semialgebraic initialization A_c, the actual append relation E_c and complete target fibre Z_c(y). Theta is unchanged by append. Every coupled component receives the SAME strict physical tuple. Finite legal paths correspond in both directions to finite actual sources.

Take the disjoint union X of these finite-dimensional spaces, keeping c as a discrete tag. Set A=union A_c, Z=union Z_c(y), and E=union E_c. There are no edges between different core tags. Static parameters and all joint components remain in q. Let s,t:E -> X be source and destination projections. If physical witnesses u are retained in the edge space, s and t simply forget u.

For purposes of the raw hierarchy below, X is the compiler's ambient state space with its specified static legality conditions; target kernels are not assumed to have already passed every valid reachable-state invariant. No source-validity claim is made for an arbitrary point of Z. That distinction is necessary in any reachability formulation.

## 3. Inherited exact positive flow and integer optimal value

Use finite positive Borel measures mu_0, mu_T and nu, concentrated respectively on A, Z and E. Require

    mu_0(X)=mu_T(X)=1,
    mu_T - mu_0 = t_*nu - s_*nu.                         (F)

The last equality is equality of finite Borel measures, equivalently equality of integrals of EVERY bounded Borel function. These are mathematical measures, not randomized physical sources. In particular terminal support is pointwise in Z(y); requiring only that average observed responses equal y would be an invalid relaxation. A nonnegative squared whole-profile residual with zero integral can enforce terminal support in Z when the state domain and compiler are kept unchanged.

Let L be the least legal append count from A to Z, or infinity if there is no such path.

**Theorem 1 (inherited [S5], proof restated).** (F) is feasible exactly when the original input is YES. When feasible,

    minimum nu(E) = L,

and an atomic flow from a shortest actual path attains the minimum.

**Proof.** For integer N>=1 let R_j be the states reachable from A using at most j legal appends. Each R_j is semialgebraic, by finite composition and real quantifier elimination. Define

    d_N(q)=min(N,d(q)),
    d(q)=least j with q in R_j, with d(q)=infinity otherwise.

Thus d_N is bounded, Borel and indeed semialgebraic, with a finite piecewise-integer formula. It is zero on A. Every legal edge satisfies

    d_N(t(e))-d_N(s(e)) <= 1.

If the source endpoint is reachable, append that edge to a shortest path. If it is unreachable, d_N(s(e))=N and the inequality is automatic. Truncation preserves the inequality.

Every target state has d_N >= min(N,L), interpreting min(N,infinity)=N. Integrate (F) against d_N:

    min(N,L) <= integral d_N dmu_T
              = integral [d_N(t(e))-d_N(s(e))] dnu
              <= nu(E).

If L=infinity this contradicts finiteness of nu(E) for sufficiently large N. If L is finite, choose N>=L to obtain nu(E)>=L. Conversely a length-L legal path q_0,...,q_L gives mu_0=delta_(q_0), mu_T=delta_(q_L), and nu the sum of its L edge atoms; the balance telescopes. For L=0 use nu=0. The accepted source correspondence then reconstructs one actual finite source. QED.

This proof avoids any unproved trajectory-disintegration theorem. Mixing core tags or theta assignments cannot create a fractional source solution: d_N is defined on the complete tagged state, and the same bound applies to all such mixtures. No finite bound on nu(E) was assumed.

The theorem gives no effective method of presenting or finding an arbitrary measure solution. A finite moment vector is not a measure solution to (F).

## 4. What duality would still have to establish

For each N, d_N is a finite exact lower-bound certificate. On a NO input these lower bounds are unbounded, but no finite N proves that L=infinity. Their construction is just finite-length reachability and does not eliminate the master quantifier.

A bounded Borel separator is available abstractly: the indicator of the reachable set R=union_j R_j. R is Borel and forward invariant, so integrating its indicator rules out (F) on a NO. This does not give finite formula syntax: the union ranges over ALL lengths. Replacing that indicator by a finite L_exp-definable invariant is precisely the accepted architecture's unproved source-coverage implication [S4].

One might instead hope that finite-dimensional convex duality after finitely many polynomial tests supplies an infeasibility certificate. Section 5 disproves blanket finite termination for that raw hierarchy. General infinite-dimensional LP terminology cannot replace a proof of that implication.

## 5. An original all-core NO with feasible exact finite polynomial flow levels

### 5.1 Legal original input and actual source subfamily

Use the natural COMMON experiment with two focal copies A_1,A_2 and one copy from each of three other taxa B,C,D. Apply the permitted finite coarsening: restrict the final rooted genealogy to A_1,A_2,B and report whether A_1,A_2 form a clade. The supplied Bernoulli response is

    probability of focal monophyly = 1.

This is a rational probability input to the original finite coarsening contract. It is a NO across EVERY finite strictly positive admitted source, not just one chosen core.

Indeed there is positive probability that all sampled current roots experience no merger on every finite population segment below the unbounded ancestral population, along one allowed routing history. All relevant durations are finite and all natural routing probabilities are interior; there are finitely many events. At ancestral entry the sampled roots are distinct. There is then positive probability that the first ancestral merger joins A_1 to B. That rooted clade persists after restricting away C,D and precludes the reported focal clade. Therefore the requested probability is strictly below one in every finite admitted source. This argument retains current-lineage semantics and needs no bound on graph size.

Fix an ordinary four-taxon tree core with rational interior survivals elsewhere and its eligible pendant-A slot. Write q(z) for its full capped state with that slot equal to the ordinary kernel E(z), 0<=z<=1. The extension to z=0 is polynomial in survival coordinates; it is an abstract terminal state, not a strict physical source. At q(0), the two focal A roots merge inside that slot with certainty, so q(0) lies in the whole target fibre for the stated observation.

Let z_0=1/2, a=1/4, z_n=z_0 a^n. Every q(z_n) is an actual finite strict source state. At every step use the literal permitted COMMON append

    B_COMMON(1/2,1/2,1/2) E(1/2) = E(1/4).

The equality holds for the whole finite forest kernel: a COMMON choice between identical ordinary arms has the same ordinary kernel, and ordinary kernels compose by multiplying survivals. Thus e_n=(q(z_n),u,q(z_(n+1))) is a legal strict physical edge with the same interior tuple u=(1/2,1/2,1/2,1/2). Using this tuple in our witnesses adds no constraint to the input or to arbitrary rival sources.

### 5.2 Every finite polynomial test family admits a finite atomic fake flow

Fix ANY finite list of polynomial state tests f_1,...,f_r, including arbitrary cross-coordinate polynomials of the COMPLETE coupled state. Along the fixed core curve q(z), each

    P_i(z)=f_i(q(z))

is a univariate polynomial. Put Delta_i(z)=P_i(a z)-P_i(z). Its constant term is zero, so |Delta_i(z)| <= C_i z on [0,z_0]. Consequently

    sum_(n>=0) |Delta_i(z_n)| < infinity,
    sum_(n>=0) Delta_i(z_n) = P_i(0)-P_i(z_0).           (T)

Apply the finite positive cubature statement in [P2, Corollary 2] to counting measure on the actual discrete edge index set n>=0 and the integrable vector (Delta_1(z_n),...,Delta_r(z_n)). Counting measure has infinite mass, which [P2, Remark 2] explicitly permits when the selected functions are integrable. There are finitely many ACTUAL indices n_j and positive finite weights w_j with

    sum_j w_j Delta_i(z_(n_j)) = P_i(0)-P_i(z_0)
    for every i.                                      (C)

If all increments are zero, nu=0 already suffices for this finite list. Otherwise take

    mu_0=delta_(q(z_0)),
    mu_T=delta_(q(0)),
    nu=sum_j w_j delta_(e_(n_j)).

Every transition atom is a literal legal strict append between actual source states. Both endpoint probability measures have mass one, and the terminal atom fits the original target row exactly. Equation (C) is EXACT equality for every selected polynomial test. There is no signed measure, fractional physical factor, approximate numerical equality, added source letter, or boundary control in these edge atoms. The noninteger weights belong only to the proposed mathematical flow relaxation.

These measures do NOT satisfy full balance (F), by Theorem 1. Different finite test lists generally need different measures. All polynomial tests simultaneously would determine the compactly supported finite endpoint/marginal measures and imply full balance; no single finite nu works for all of them.

**Theorem 2.** The raw full-source positive-flow relaxation that checks any finite polynomial test list is feasible on this original rational all-core NO. In particular merely increasing polynomial degree, with no additional reachable-state invariant, cannot be a guaranteed finite NO procedure.

Since the witness measures are positive and atomic, every moment/localizing positivity condition valid on their stated supports also holds. The assertion concerns finite tests of balance, not every imaginable augmented SDP formulation or a solver's numerical behavior.

### 5.3 Exact small check, and a qualified divergence statement

For scalar tests z and z^2, the two actual edges with source values 1/2 and 1/8 and weights

    44/45, 64/45

satisfy both balances with initial value 1/2 and terminal value zero:

    sum_j w_j z_j = 2/3,
    sum_j w_j z_j^2 = 4/15.

Multiplying by a-1=-3/4 and a^2-1=-15/16 gives respectively -1/2 and -1/4, the exact terminal-minus-initial moments. A short standard-library rational check is included. It checks these two scalar equalities only; Theorem 2 for every finite full-state list is the hand cubature argument, not a computation.

If one restricts the constructed fake flows to the displayed fixed-a edges 0<z<=z_0, their required mass cannot remain bounded as all scalar degrees are added. For the degree-D polynomial

    h_D(z)=sum_(k=1)^D (1-z/z_0)^k/k,

h_D(0)-h_D(z_0)=H_D, while

    0 <= h_D(a z)-h_D(z) <= log(1/a)=log 4.

The last bound follows by comparing the positive summands with their infinite geometric-log series for z>0. Therefore degree-D balance forces nu(E)>=H_D/log 4. This is ONLY a bound for that fixed contraction-edge family. It is not a lower bound for optimal mass in the full freely controlled truncated source problem, which permits many other edges.

## 6. Finite semialgebraic flow tests give exactly the existing separator language

This further comparison addresses the suggested repair by allowing arbitrary finite semialgebraic tests, including discontinuous ones. It is a semantic equivalence, not a new source-coverage theorem.

**Theorem 3.** There exists a finite semialgebraic state-test list whose positive atomic unit-flow balance is infeasible if and only if there exists a semialgebraic inductive set containing A and disjoint from Z. Coefficients may be arbitrary real numbers, shared throughout the certificate. On the finite tagged core union, this is equivalent to the existing simultaneous all-core separator family.

A finite test list f=(f_1,...,f_r) consists of everywhere-defined semialgebraic real functions on X. Its atomic relaxation allows finitely many positive atoms in A, Z and E with unit initial/terminal mass and balance only for these tests. Allowing finite measures with integrable selected functions instead gives the same finite-test feasibility: finite cubature preserves their finitely many integrals, including endpoint masses.

**Finite-dimensional conic lemma.** If C is a convex cone in R^d, not necessarily closed, and b is outside C, there are at most d covectors c_1,...,c_k such that

    (c_1(g),...,c_k(g)) >=_lex 0 for every g in C,
    (c_1(b),...,c_k(b)) <_lex 0.

Here lexicographic sign means the sign of the first nonzero entry, with the all-zero vector nonnegative.

Proof: work in W=span(C). If b is outside W, a linear functional vanishing on W and negative at b finishes. Otherwise, if b is outside closure_W(C), closed-cone separation supplies a functional nonnegative on C and negative at b. In the remaining case b lies in closure_W(C) minus C. Since a convex set has the same relative interior as its closure, b is a boundary point. A nonzero supporting functional c_1 on W is nonnegative on C and zero at b. Set C_0=C intersect ker(c_1). It is a convex cone in a strictly smaller-dimensional space and b is still outside it. Recurse there and extend its covectors linearly to W and then R^d. For a vector of C with c_1>0, the first sign already works; for one with c_1=0, the recursive signs work. The value at b has first entry zero and the recursive negative sign. Dimensions strictly decrease. This proves the lemma without replacing C by its closure at the decisive membership test.

**Proof of Theorem 3, nontrivial direction.** Define augmented state features

    v(q)=(f(q),1,0),     b=(0,...,0,0,1) in R^(r+2).

Form the column set G consisting of:
- actual edge columns (f(q')-f(q),0,0);
- initialization columns (f(a),1,0), a in A;
- terminal columns (-f(z),-1,1), z in Z.

The final coordinate of a conic representation of b forces total terminal weight one. The penultimate coordinate then forces total initialization weight one. The first r coordinates are precisely the finite-test balance equations. Thus finite-test feasibility is equivalent to b belonging to cone(G), using ordinary FINITE nonnegative combinations. Zero weights may be omitted. There is no closure or source-mixing purification assumption in this equivalence.

If the relaxation is infeasible, apply the conic lemma to C=cone(G). Let

    p(q)=(c_j(v(q)))_(j=1,...,k),    p_T=(c_j(b))_j <_lex 0,
    I={q:p(q)>=_lex 0}.

I is semialgebraic: lexicographic comparison is a finite Boolean combination of equations and strict inequalities, and each f_j is semialgebraic.

Initialization columns give p(a)>=_lex 0. Edge columns give p(q')-p(q)>=_lex 0, so I is forward invariant under EVERY actual append. Terminal columns give p_T-p(z)>=_lex 0, whence p(z)<=_lex p_T<_lex 0. Therefore I excludes the WHOLE target fibre.

For the converse, take the single semialgebraic test f=1_I. It is one on A and zero on Z, while forward invariance makes f(q')-f(q)>=0 on every edge. Unit flow would require -1 to equal a nonnegative edge integral, impossible. QED.

Because there are finitely many disjoint core tags, a finite family of semialgebraic invariants combines into one semialgebraic I on X, and restriction of I recovers the family. Theta never changes along an edge; no separate coefficient or physical assignment is selected per row. The covectors in the forward proof are ONE fixed finite tuple for initialization, preservation and exclusion.

The same semantic proof works for any expansion of the ordered real field in which the chosen functions and finite Boolean combinations are definable, including L_exp. It does not assert a new recursive proof-completeness theorem for that expansion. For semialgebraic tests described with rational/effectively algebraic coefficients, finite conic membership can also be written as an RCF sentence with at most r+2 generator atoms by conic Caratheodory. A finite algebraic syntax template may instead quantify its unknown real coefficients jointly. These are effective RCF settings already within the inherited verifier framework. Arbitrary real coefficients remain allowed in the semantic theorem, but are not thereby effective supplied input or an equality oracle.

Consequently the strengthened proposal does not evade the missing G3 implication. Finite semialgebraic-test flow exclusion is EXACTLY semialgebraic inductive-separator existence; finite exponential-test exclusion has the corresponding semantic exponential-separator gate. Lexicographic separation closes the nonclosed-cone detail, but cannot prove that every original NO has one of these finite certificates.


## 7. Why strict-domain repair does not yet close G3

The example is deliberately inside the actual source grammar, but it is not a hard new negative input. Every finite strict source has positive no-merger diagonal coordinates. Adding that known strict invariant to the allowed terminal state domain excludes q(0). Together with the ordinary nonnegative normalized forest-carrier invariants, no-merger positivity gives the all-core rejection argument above. Positivity of a selected diagonal alone on an otherwise unrestricted signed ambient kernel is not asserted to exclude the whole target fibre. Equivalently, a semialgebraic positivity invariant proves its NO without moment hierarchy search.

That repair is sound. What is unproved is that some effectively discovered finite collection of such strict invariant restrictions excludes the entire target fibre for EVERY original NO. Exhausting all finite semialgebraic restrictions returns to the established invariant-coverage problem; allowing exponential restrictions returns to [S4]. It is not legitimate to assume the target state already lies in the exact reachable image, since that would presolve G3.

Coercive penalties enforcing distance from forbidden boundaries, or a fixed occupation-mass budget, similarly give bounded subproblems. Removing their unbounded budget requires a new theorem. Theorem 1 states the unbounded mass optimum exactly, but does not decide whether it is infinite. No unsupported assertion of strong duality, finite convergence or effective extraction is made.

Thus the full duality attempt stops at a precisely falsified finite-moment completion step. A more powerful dual language may still work. The accepted exponential architecture remains sound and incomplete; this note neither proves its coverage nor constructs an original NO without its certificates.

## 8. Sources, attribution and verification status

- [S1] [Original master](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/63d39b70b5b39b5511bd24ef26a413a8f7228f16/research/2026-10-05-dot-original-g-master-priority-1913z/MASTER-STATEMENTS.md), blob aea996450f5a81ba9f379cf518a0e6991545cdda. Fresh complete read.
- [S2] [Canonical scope](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/63d39b70b5b39b5511bd24ef26a413a8f7228f16/research/2026-10-07-dot-full-scope-reconciliation-1003z/CURRENT-SCOPE.md), blob 9ece6d2498e80d12c25ae6c1fdf8e52f0178012f. Governing original scope and final appendix reread; no new audit of every older theorem.
- [S3] [Exact source reachability reduction](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/63d39b70b5b39b5511bd24ef26a413a8f7228f16/research/2026-10-06-dot-g3-global-source-reachability-0019z/REDUCTION.md), blob ee93672cb099a504bd8a2d0730ec8ef08f4b0ace. Fresh complete read. Source compiler, core enumeration and polynomial ordinary kernels are inherited.
- [S4] [Accepted exponential proof architecture](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/63d39b70b5b39b5511bd24ef26a413a8f7228f16/research/2026-10-09-dot-full-attempt-wave-0542z/g3-certificates/EXPONENTIAL-PROOF-CERTIFICATES-AND-SOURCE-COVERAGE.md), blob a11bff90e34a97ef59af0c85816aecc30484804d. Fresh complete read. Soundness is not treated as coverage.
- [S5] [Inherited full mass/terminal attempt](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/63d39b70b5b39b5511bd24ef26a413a8f7228f16/research/2026-10-08-codex-g3-g4-full-shot-1253z/g3-impossibility/occupation-mass-terminal/FULL-MASS-AND-TERMINAL-ATTEMPT.md), blob 7fdf6baca14dedf8eb6955b833bdb3f10c98151b. Fresh complete read after the recognition reviewer identified the prior equivalence. Its Sections 1–3 already state the minimum-mass theorem and explain the finite-test gap.
- [P1] Weiqiao Han and Russ Tedrake, [Controller Synthesis for Discrete-Time Polynomial Systems via Occupation Measures](https://arxiv.org/pdf/1803.09022), arXiv:1803.09022v2, 26 July 2018. Its controlled measure balance and moment/SOS approximations motivate the attempted architecture; its compact control/state assumptions and approximation results are not imported as exact unknown-length recognition.
- [P2] Christian Bayer and Josef Teichmann, [The proof of Tchakaloff's Theorem](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0502473), arXiv:math/0502473v2, 4 May 2005; Proceedings of the AMS 134 (2006), 3035–3040, DOI 10.1090/S0002-9939-06-08249-9. Corollary 2 and Remark 2 supply cubature for finitely many integrable functions, with nodes in the specified measurable full-measure set, even for infinite total measure. These exact clauses ensure no boundary node is substituted for a legal edge.

The occupation-flow equivalence and its truncated-distance proof already occur in the accepted 8 October provider [S5], which itself credits the earlier dot proof. That provider also preserves a finite-test redundancy counterexample on a YES endpoint and explicitly says it does not give a NO passing every relaxation. Section 5 here supplies that latter, narrower failure for the raw hierarchy, on an easy boundary NO. Occupation-measure convexification, finite cubature, shortest-path dual functions and the easy positivity NO retain classical/source attribution. No historical novelty claim is made. The all-core source interpretation and finite-test obstruction are the deductions inspected here.

# Independent recognition-lane review: exact flow and finite-test boundary

Reviewer: dot (OpenAI), G3 recognition lane, 9 October 2026.
Verdict: SCOPED HAND ACCEPTANCE.

Reviewed final body: EXACT-FLOW-DUALITY-AND-FINITE-MOMENT-OBSTRUCTION.md.
SHA256: bbc2515e6c1fed2c10f8de5985e47242298468629a3009567e520c399724e53d.

## 1. Exact scope accepted

The inherited positive finite-flow formulation is equivalent to original source reachability, with minimum total transition mass equal to shortest append count. The restart does not claim that equivalence as new. The new inspected consequences are:
- the stated easy original all-core NO has exact positive atomic solutions at EVERY finite polynomial-balance level of the raw hierarchy;
- allowing finite semialgebraic state tests gives an infeasibility certificate exactly when a semialgebraic inductive separator exists, with one shared coefficient tuple and the whole target fibre retained.

Neither conclusion proves general G3 decidability, undecidability, separator incompleteness or failure of invariant-strengthened moment methods.

## 2. Full-measure equivalence and quantifiers

The truncated shortest-path function d_N is bounded and Borel; its sublevel sets are finite semialgebraic reachability layers. It is zero on all initialization states, has edge increment at most one and is at least min(N,L) everywhere on the complete target fibre. Integration against finite measures therefore gives min(N,L)<=nu(E). Letting N grow excludes exact finite flow on a NO; a shortest actual path supplies an atomic optimum on a YES.

Disjoint core tags and the unchanged static physical tuple are retained in the state. Mixtures cannot bypass the distance inequality. Terminal support means membership in the entire exact fibre, not merely agreement of averaged response coordinates. There is no hidden finite-mass bound and no unsupported infinite path disintegration.

## 3. Raw finite-polynomial counterexample

The input monophyly probability one is allowed by the original probability-profile encoding. I freshly reread the original exact criterion, whose profile space includes [0,1]; strict positivity concerns the source parameters.

For every finite natural source there is positive probability of no finite-population merger, followed by an ancestral merger of A_1 with B. This prevents the A_1,A_2 clade after the declared restriction. Hence the input is an all-core NO. At the raw polynomial state q(0), the A pair is already merged with certainty, so it belongs to the target fibre without being a strict source.

The equal-arm COMMON append B(1/2,1/2,1/2)E(1/2)=E(1/4) is an exact whole-kernel equality. Every displayed edge atom has strictly interior physical controls and actual source endpoints q(z_n), z_n>0. The sole boundary object is the terminal measure atom q(0).

Every polynomial of the complete state restricts to a polynomial in z. Its transition increments have zero constant term and are absolutely summable along z_n=2^{-1}4^{-n}. Telescoping gives the desired finite-test balances.

I independently opened Bayer–Teichmann, arXiv:math/0502473v2, and checked Corollary 2 and Remark 2. Their cubature conclusion permits integrable selected functions under infinite total measure and chooses nodes in the specified full-measure set. It therefore applies to the actual discrete indices, without introducing a boundary transition node. The resulting finite weights belong to the mathematical relaxation, not to fractional physical source factors.

The two scalar balances and the harmonic lower bound are correct by direct arithmetic/series inspection. The latter is confined to the displayed fixed-contraction edge family, as required; no unrestricted optimal-mass lower bound is inferred.

The final body incorporates my requested qualification: positive diagonals exclude the displayed q(0), while global direct rejection also retains the nonnegative normalized forest-carrier invariants. Positivity of selected diagonals alone on arbitrary signed ambient kernels is not claimed sufficient.

## 4. Finite semialgebraic tests and lexicographic separators

The augmented conic columns correctly enforce unit initial/terminal masses and all selected feature balances. Ordinary finite conic membership, not membership in its closure, is the relevant condition.

The nonclosed-cone lemma is valid. If b is in closure(C) but not C, it is outside the relative interior, since ri(C)=ri(closure(C)) is contained in C. A supporting functional through zero restricts the unresolved cone and b to a proper lower-dimensional subspace. Repetition ends with strict separation; lexicographic ordering preserves nonnegativity of every earlier separated generator. If b lies outside the current span, a functional vanishing on that span finishes immediately.

The invariant built from the fixed covector tuple contains every initialization state, is preserved by EVERY actual edge, and excludes EVERY target state. The terminal column gives p(z)<=lex p_T<lex0; initialization and edges use the same tuple. Conversely the indicator of a semialgebraic invariant is a semialgebraic test with terminal-minus-initial value -1 and nonnegative edge increments.

This converse is for semialgebraic tests, not polynomial tests. The final body maintains that distinction. Tagged-core families and L_exp-definable semantic variants are handled correctly, without importing effective exponential truth or certificate coverage.

The final effectivity clarification is also correct: RCF decision applies to effectively algebraic finite descriptions, or finite algebraic templates with unknown coefficients jointly quantified. Arbitrary real coefficients support the semantic theorem but are not directly executable encoded input.

## 5. Sources, prior attribution and execution

I read the full final draft, its exact rational receipt, the source reachability reduction, original exact criterion and the cited primary cubature clauses. The older minimum-mass result was identified from canonical scope and is now credited to the 8 October provider, rather than presented as a new theorem.

No independent numerical run, QE, source compilation, moment solver or Lean build was performed in this review. The author's receipt checks two scalar rational balances only; the every-finite-list and lexicographic results are hand arguments.

General original G3 remains OPEN. The packet supports the stated raw-hierarchy counterexample and exact identification of the strengthened finite-test language with the inherited invariant-coverage obligation.

# Independent hand review: G3 reciprocal-power bound and retuned-head control

Reviewer: dot. Date: 16 October 2026, 00:55 UTC.
Target: [Codex candidate 03](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/330de2ade679131ca7d4ddf00db6b323d2d43bd6/handoffs/2026-10-16-codex-g3-unreviewed-source-copy-001/INPUT-RADICAL-BOUND-AND-FULL-SOURCE-TEST-03.md).

## Verdict

Scoped hand review: no substantive flaw found in the reciprocal-power obstruction, its repeated-one-type COMMON application with the stated exceptional alternative, or the six-coordinate retuned-head construction. This review uses the inherited COMMON moment compiler and calibrated embedding as providers. It does not independently reconstruct every earlier graph-source proof, execute the proposed algorithms, establish historical novelty, or provide Lean verification. General G3 and G4 remain open.

## Checks performed

1. **Radical theorem scope.** Read the primary [Carr–O'Sullivan Theorem 1.1](https://arxiv.org/pdf/math/0703522v2): it applies to real field extensions, not merely rational radicals. For distinct positive bases, a ratio of their positive n-th roots outside K gives pairwise K-linear independence. The one/two-element cases and positivity qualification are correctly separated.
2. **Effective height gap.** The coefficient bound follows from the minimal-polynomial Mahler measure: degree at most D and height below 1 imply coefficient magnitudes below 6^D. Enumeration is finite; roots are algebraic, and each positive root other than 1 has positive height. Effective approximation therefore yields a positive rational lower bound without requiring a general zero test on logarithmic expressions. The argument is inefficient but establishes computability under the stated effective algebraic representation.
3. **Polynomial grouping.** Grouping monomials by exact positive algebraic value correctly detects cancellation along the real-power curve. The finite radical-denominator bounds then exclude all sufficiently large integer n when at least one nonzero group remains. Rational prime-valuation differences give the stated sharper bound. This applies to one fixed input vector, not independently varying hidden bases.
4. **Physical one-type branch.** The substitution b=A^(1/n) is reversible within (0,1). Effective elimination supplies polynomial identities; failure of one identity along the power curve gives a finite candidate range. The all-identities-zero case remains UNKNOWN. Zariski closure alone does not supply a strict positive witness.
5. **Six-coordinate rank.** With six distinct grades, an annihilating sparse polynomial would have three distinct positive double roots and the additional root at 1. Descartes bounds its positive roots, with multiplicity, by at most six. The seven-root contradiction is valid. The entry bound 42p, six-column row bound 252p and inverse-norm choice p0=1/(1024 B0) imply an invertible scaled Jacobian; restoring nonzero column factors preserves rank.
6. **Fixed-input retuning.** The inverse-function neighborhood is inside the strict three-cell image. For each fixed n a sufficiently small positive rational tail probability leaves the divided target in that neighborhood. For the explicit tail 1/n^2, Bernoulli's inequality gives convergence and eventual inclusion. RCF transfer yields algebraic strict heads for each exact polynomial fibre. This is an exact common six-coordinate solution, not six separately fitted rows.
7. **Original-source scope.** Read the inherited [calibrated source construction](../2026-10-06-dot-g3-calibrated-original-recognition-1422z/WORKING-PROOF-R2.md) and [minimum-count corollary](../2026-10-06-dot-g3-calibrated-original-recognition-1422z/CALIBRATED-WITNESS-SIZE-COROLLARY.md). The candidate uses their COMMON slice and rational affine eight-row input. The reverse embedding already supplies the short head-only original witness; no all-INDEPENDENT conclusion is inferred.
8. **Prime-support warning.** If n is divisible by every prime in a proposed finite set including 2, the numerator 2n²−1 has a prime outside that set and is coprime to its denominator. Cancellation concerns the rational aggregate head moment, not the individual possibly algebraic head factors. This is a restriction on all presentations, not on existence of a short representative.

## Meaning and remaining obligation

The useful arithmetic contribution bounds repetition in a proper, input-controlled one-type branch. The retuned-head construction demonstrates why an unrestricted extension fails: one fixed rational input can have arbitrarily long presentations while already having a witness with at most three hybrids.

This does not refute an input-dependent minimum-witness bound. The next decisive obligation is a source-complete reduction covering varying singular heads, independent multiplicities, exceptional toric branches and one original coupled observation fibre. A bounded number of cell types does not bound their multiplicities. Preserve COMMON/INDEPENDENT distinctions and all original quantifiers.

## Evidence limits and credit

documents.body:
# What the hemlock integration establishes and what comes next

Codex G6 scientific integration, 8 October 2026. This note describes the confirmed Linda Raubeson/Holman hemlock question. It supplies no professor endorsement or contact, new empirical capture verdict, live API call, or completed G6 biological admission.

The immediate result is a reproducible, small **actual-sequence comparison**: the nuclear 4CL1 marker groups chinensis with caroliniana, while the plastid rbcL marker groups chinensis with Japanese sieboldii. The respective descriptive column-bootstrap supports are 100/100 and 93/100. This reproduces the direction of the reported disagreement on a deliberately smaller dataset. It does not discriminate chloroplast capture from the other processes that can produce gene-tree disagreement.

## What Holman and colleagues already established

The governing publication is *A New Species and Introgression in Eastern Asian Hemlocks (Pinaceae: Tsuga)*, Systematic Botany 42, 733–746 (2017), DOI [10.1600/036364417X696474](https://doi.org/10.1600/036364417X696474). The [USDA-hosted complete paper](https://research.fs.usda.gov/download/treesearch/55598.pdf) was actually read; its SHA256 is `81d19502fe93b40f68a8a673060670fad7e0588bb9bd186018004c372dae26ab`. The extracted text inspected here has SHA256 `9c0059d6ffcbebcf0d45c0e1bfbefd4f1473383324ede16f46cb6738936ce24a`. Methods/results are on pp.734–738; discussion on pp.738–741; specimen/accession and sequencing metrics are in Appendices1–2, including the ulleungensis treatment's specimen list.

| Published evidence | Actual reported scope and method |
|---|---|
| Nuclear sequence sampling | Tissue from 14 hemlock individuals was collected for DNA work. New 4CL sampling is reported as three diversifolia, two each of caroliniana, chinensis, Japanese sieboldii and Ulleungdo hemlocks, and one canadensis. PCR amplicons were cloned; 10–16 colonies per accession were sequenced to assess intra-individual variation. Previously published nuclear sequences supplied additional outgroup information. These are not 10–16 independently sampled genomic loci. |
| Two nuclear gene copies | Two distinct 4CL paralogs, aligned to 1,049 bp each. An ILD test found no significant difference between their phylogenetic signals, and they were concatenated: 2,098 bp, 46 parsimony-informative characters, selected HKY+I model. A nonsignificant test does not establish independent ancestry or identical genealogies. |
| Plastid sequence sampling | Nearly complete plastomes from one individual each of canadensis, caroliniana, chinensis, diversifolia, heterophylla, Japanese sieboldii and Ulleungdo hemlocks, plus Nothotsuga longibracteata. The plastid alignment is 122,525 bp, with 1,574 parsimony-informative characters; selected GTR+Γ with four rate categories. A large linked plastome is not thousands of independent ancestry blocks. |
| Original tree inference | Geneious9.0.5 sequence processing, MAFFT alignment, PAUP*4.0b10 maximum parsimony with TBR and 1,000 random-addition searches; jModelTest2.1.4/AIC model selection; GARLI2.0 maximum likelihood with 1,000 bootstrap replicates; Sumtrees3.3.1 consensus; visual and ILD incongruence comparisons. No posterior capture probability or calibrated sequence-to-G6-law channel is supplied by these procedures. |
| Rooted relationships | The reported nuclear phylogram uses canadensis as outgroup: caroliniana/chinensis is sister to the oceanic diversifolia/sieboldii/Ulleungdo clade. The plastid phylogram uses Nothotsuga as outgroup: caroliniana is sister to diversifolia/Ulleungdo (80% MP/77% ML bootstrap), and that group is sister to chinensis/Japanese sieboldii. All other plastid branches are reported with 100% MP and ML support. |
| Independent phenotypic question | Quantitative morphology used 78 wild-collected herbarium specimens; the broader common-garden morphology/phenology study included 18 individuals. Six of eleven leaf characters were retained after significance screening. Phenology was observed in 2010–2012. These support species-delimitation discussion, not a direct estimate of capture probability. |

The authors explicitly say the divergent topologies **suggest** capture of a chinensis chloroplast by Japanese sieboldii and refer to the capture as **putative**. They also discuss ancestral polymorphism/non-coalescence in conifers and possible ancient hybridization involving caroliniana. The described analysis compares gene trees and morphology; it does not fit and discriminate a declared capture model against an incomplete-lineage-sorting model. Strong support for a marker tree is not the probability of its proposed historical cause. The capture suggestion is already the authors' result; rediscovering the discordance is not a new biological finding.

## Actual recoverable data and our addition

The [Dryad dataset](https://datadryad.org/dataset/doi:10.5061/dryad.2r12j), version21609, has CC0 metadata and four inventoried files: separate 4CL alignments, concatenated 4CL alignments, whole-plastid alignments, and a needle-morphology CSV. [Metadata](DRYAD-DATASET-METADATA.json) and [file inventory](DRYAD-FILE-INVENTORY.json) were retrieved; original download attempts returned401/403, which remain saved. No successful full-alignment retrieval or full-paper replication is claimed. The inventory alone does not provide raw sequencing reads or clone chromatograms.

An alternative standard anonymous GenBank retrieval returned 15 versioned records: plastid/4CL1/4CL2 for five paper-listed species. The tiny pilot uses eight of those records, cpDNA plus 4CL1 for the **same four paper-listed specimens** of chinensis, caroliniana, Japanese sieboldii and diversifolia. [The exact source and processing manifest](REAL-BASELINE/MANIFEST.json) retains each accession, voucher join, annotation, raw hash and recipe. NCBI's no-restrictions-on-reuse policy is recorded separately from depositor IP rights; GenBank deposits are not relabelled CC0 or Apache. chinensis rbcL has no deposited gene annotation: its candidate region is explicitly homology-inferred using 33 consistent 40-base exact anchors and coding-boundary checks.

Our actual additions are source/specimen traceability, an accessible offline comparison, exact preserved preprocessing and original software receipt replay, an explicit uncertainty/admission boundary, and executable controls for the original mathematical source solver. The pilot uses one 1,048-site nuclear marker and one 1,428-site plastid marker, unique reference-centered global alignments, uncorrected-distance neighbor joining and 100 fixed-seed column-bootstrap draws. It omits ulleungensis, population replication and outgroups, and therefore does not reproduce the paper's rooted relationships or identify capture direction. Marker choice before tree outcomes is author-reported; no immutable independent preregistration pin exists.

Two separate **synthetic exact-law controls** demonstrate that the original source producer/checker can distinguish different displayed-split targets within its complete declared 15-source, zero-hybrid registry. The real Tsuga intake instead produces a checked UNKNOWN/NOT_ADMITTED result. These are different evidential steps. Our established mathematics supplies conditional target/source contracts and shared-source requirements; it does not turn the estimated marker trees into exact calendar genealogy laws, infer every hidden edge, or prove an empirical capture history.

## Concrete milestones toward a useful scientific analysis

1. **Complete the published-data replay.** Obtain the original permitted NEXUS/CSV bytes through a working public route and authenticate their recorded deposit hashes. Preserve every specimen, allele/clone and paralog ID; reproduce the separate and combined 4CL and whole-plastid analyses with the original roots/model settings, then show method and alignment sensitivity. Done means published inputs and reported relationships are auditable, including disagreements; a replacement alignment must remain labelled a reconstruction.
2. **Define biological observation units.** Audit the two 4CL copies' orthology/paralogy and clone/allele assignments; establish which nuclear regions are genuinely independent, and retain whole-plastid linkage. Justify Tsuga's compartment-specific transmission and any recombination/partition model from appropriate evidence. Add justified multi-individual nuclear sampling or additional existing public independent loci where available. Done means a model has justified units and inheritance premises, rather than counting aligned sites or clones as iid loci.
3. **Compare explicit competing explanations.** Predeclare a bifurcating species history with incomplete lineage sorting; a history with plastid introgression/capture; and, if justified, alternatives involving older caroliniana introgression or an unsampled ancestral lineage. Separately test sensitivity to gene-tree error, substitution-model misspecification and paralog/phase assignment. Fit these using an established, suitable coalescent/network implementation and the same admitted observations; use model adequacy and calibrated simulation or predictive comparison. Posterior or likelihood preferences must state priors, sampling/model assumptions and unresolved equivalent histories. Our existing fixed-six-copy clock-JC/pulse numerical solver has a different input contract and cannot silently fit these hemlock matrices.
4. **Build the sequence-to-source bridge.** Propagate alignment, tree, phase and sampling uncertainty into a declared joint observation law/confidence object with a justified error calibration. Use one original source and shared parameter bank where the model requires them; do not pool linked plastid genes or separate compartments as independent genealogies by default. The current G6 fixed-calendar bank gate covers a narrow exact component; the general all-source effective image/certification interface and empirical channel remain open. Done means the practical solver receives a valid biological contract, or a precise refusal reports the remaining premise.
5. **Return an interpretable comparison.** The application should show baseline relationships, which declared history/target classes remain compatible, uncertainty and sensitivity, source receipts and reproducible commands on the same data. State separately whether reticulation is supported, whether plastid capture is distinguishable from alternatives, and whether direction/timing are identifiable. A useful result may exclude a model or show that several histories remain possible. No method guarantees a definitive answer from these two nuclear paralogs and one plastid history; extra independent evidence may be necessary.

This path needs no AlphaGenome call: hemlock tree/history analysis is a separate plant scientific lane, and current AlphaGenome/molecular work has human/mouse contracts. The implemented pilot, source controls and public workbench all run offline. An API is a delivery interface, not a substitute for additional independent observations or the missing model/channel justification. Root owns any broader application/API choice.

For today's actual comparison, run `python3 research/2026-10-08-codex-integration-0825z/g6/cwu_baseline.py` from repository root. To recompute the real marker pilot with Biopython1.88, run `python research/2026-10-08-codex-integration-0825z/g6/prepare_real_baseline.py --output /absolute/new-directory`; an existing directory is refused. To reproduce synthetic controls with their pinned dependencies, run `python run_cwu_demo.py --output /absolute/new-control-directory` from this packet directory. The inherited control script's historical default is preserved; use the explicit fresh output path. Root's friendly application already selects fresh directories and labels saved versus newly executed receipts.

documents.title: A stronger fixed-temperature Gibbs equality-testing lower bound
documents.body:
# A stronger fixed-temperature Gibbs equality-testing lower bound

18 October 2026. Research by dot (OpenAI), working with Nolan.

**Accepted at the stated assistant-context hand-proof scope.** The unchanged producing-pass candidate is accompanied by separate statistical and physical/reduction reviews. Their later verdicts govern the packet's status. The bounded exact checks supplement those parameterized hand proofs. This is not external peer review, Lean verification, a historical-novelty finding, or a solution of the full optimal-copy problem.

## Result and assumptions

Fix an integer `k >= 5`, inverse temperature `beta > 0`, and accuracy `0 < epsilon <= 1/4096`. For every sufficiently large physical size `N`, equality testing of two unknown Gibbs states requires

    Omega_{k,beta,epsilon}(N^a / (log N)^(a/(k-1))),
    a = min{(2k+2)/3, (4k-1)/5}.

The promise is exact equality versus **full trace norm at least epsilon**. Each Hamiltonian is at most k-local, with each nonidentity Pauli coefficient bounded by one in magnitude. There is no bounded-degree or bounded-per-site-total-strength restriction. The lower bound allows arbitrary collective quantum measurements and adaptive choice of source, and counts the worst-case TOTAL copies across both sources. The hard subclass is diagonal. Every label, clone, data, reservoir and padding spin is counted.

- For `k=5`: exponent `19/5`, with logarithmic denominator power `19/20`.
- For `k=6`: exponent `23/5`, with logarithmic denominator power `23/25`.
- For `k>=7`: exponent `(2k+2)/3`, with logarithmic denominator power `(2k+2)/(3(k-1))`.

These are fixed-parameter asymptotic statements; constants and size thresholds may depend on k, beta and epsilon. No new k=3 or k=4 result is asserted. The general collective upper bound and this lower bound still leave a gap.

## What changes, and what is reused

The prior draws one light-coordinate fraction from Beta(3,3) for each label, and holds it fixed across both sources and all copies. It also makes common fixed random bit flips. An integration-by-parts score bound suppresses the full two-copy row information. A separate all-count likelihood estimate controls every higher count, including the shared label-mass denominator. Conditioning on far alternatives and the normalized physical-copy simulation are included in the proof.

The precise distinction from the earlier alphabet ceilings is that the bit flips introduce complemented light means `1-ell` and `1-ell +/- delta`, outside their declared alphabet. Prior correlation alone would not evade a pointwise tester. See the separate clarification, which supplements the candidate's compressed comparison paragraph.

Physical admission is reused from [component30](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/75077b740d7a6c44aee69cbd776aea5e26a43014/research/2026-10-16-g6-gibbs-certification/conditional-qubit-admission-30/README.md), with common source-independent guards and inverse-polynomial leakage. The random-mass construction and denominator build on [component29](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/603e52474aa12a2b7f0131a02e6508249d9dc616/research/2026-10-16-g6-gibbs-certification/random-label-masses-29/README.md). The earlier [alphabet ceilings](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/4e9bbabbf28b96beee04bef9f0352979f40611c6/research/2026-10-16-g6-gibbs-certification/random-label-masses-29/ceilings/unequal-marginals-29c/README.md) and [angular-prior exclusion31](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/346f420ce6e21212e9295694bd13454842a4e9cc/research/2026-10-16-g6-gibbs-certification/angular-prior-exclusion-31/README.md) remain valid at their original scopes.

The heavy/light product-distribution method is attributed to Canonne, Diakonikolas, Kane and Stewart, [Testing Bayesian Networks, COLT2017, Section5.2/Theorem40](https://proceedings.mlr.press/v65/canonne17a/canonne17a.pdf). Score bounds, integration by parts, Poissonization and data processing are classical ingredients. Historical novelty of this particular composition has not been established.

## Evidence and reading order

1. `P1-LATENT-LIGHT-FRACTION-CANDIDATE-32.md`: unchanged complete derivation, including its historical pending-review header.
2. `P1-LATENT-LIGHT-FRACTION-CLARIFICATION-32.md`: exact distinction from the earlier conditional alphabet.
3. `P1-LATENT-LIGHT-FRACTION-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW-32.md`: separate assistant-context full statistical hand/source review.
4. `P1-LATENT-LIGHT-FRACTION-ADMISSION-INDEPENDENT-REVIEW-32.md`: separate assistant-context physical admission, farness, normalization and budget review.
5. Author and separately authored review checkers with their successful logs. They verify finite exact identities and small pair-row laws; they do not prove the all-size theorem by execution.
6. `COORDINATION-CHECKPOINT.md` and `MANIFEST.json`: the remaining full-gap obligation and exact file digests.

The full P1 optimal-copy problem remains open. This packet supplies a stronger lower-bound component, with no general tester, matching upper bound, efficient preparation claim or experimental validation.
