# Actual isolated original bigon: complete cap-three forest row

Existing G3 owner,22October2026. **HAND derivation, UNCOMPILED**. The source
declarations below were actually read at the pinned original revision. The
new copy/symmetry/observer proof candidates have not been elaborated. This
note proves a mathematical source specialization on the stated literal
fragment; it is not a new compiler receipt, a full-calendar segment identity,
a fresh-source construction or an unrestricted G3/G4 endpoint.

## Actual fragment and input

Fix an actual RootedBinary N, strict Calendar C, PositivePairRates r and an
existing G1NonrootBigonKernel.NonrootBigon B. Its two distinct original parent
arcs have the SAME original upper node B.upper, different from N.root. Let

    delta = C.age(B.upper)-C.age(B.parents.hybrid)>0,
    x = exp(-pairRate r (some B.parents.parent0)*delta),
    y = exp(-pairRate r (some B.parents.parent1)*delta),
    p = 1-gamma.

The actual native gamma is P(parent1); p is P(parent0). For strict gamma,
0<p<1 and 0<x,y<1. All quantities use the SAME actual original graph,
calendar, edge occurrences and physical rate bank. The source identity
bigonDuration=delta follows from its actual Real.toNNReal and strict C.

Use the EXISTING enteringCode at node B.parents.hybrid with one leaf for
each CURRENT entering root, its actual descendant-valid taxon chart and the
SAME register. It is also the literal initializer of actualCurrentRootCode.
The number of labels inside each earlier opaque tree is unrestricted.

The word is EXACTLY bigonProgram N C B gamma common:

    original hybrid pulse;
    interval(bigonDuration);
    exit(original parent0);
    exit(original parent1).

No global epoch/boundary is commuted or deleted. Both exits are present.
For a full original source with concurrent exterior roots, first obtain its
actual selected inside program from the closing-cohort/calendar receiver.
The all-roots-at-input premise here concerns the independently initialized
CURRENT-root Code; it is not asserted for the full exterior-containing Code.

## Complete forest support and symmetry

SourceValid.forest says every original entering-root label has a live
ancestor, each live representative is its own ancestor, and its genealogy
leaves are EXACTLY its ancestor fibre. Hence the live genealogy leaves form
a partition of the complete entering-root label set. Every block is nonempty
(it contains its representative); different live genealogies have disjoint
leaf sets. Actual source operations and coding preserve these facts.

With labels a,b,c, the full rooted UNRANKED forest therefore has exactly
seven possibilities, not merely seven selected diagonal coordinates:

    F0 = a | b | c;
    Fab = (ab) | c, Fac = (ac) | b, Fbc = (bc) | a;
    Tab = ((ab)c), Tac = ((ac)b), Tbc = ((bc)a).

To check exhaustiveness: a three-element set has partitions of sizes 3,
2+1 or 3. A singleton well-labelled binary tree is a leaf. A two-leaf
well-labelled binary tree has only its one child-swap quotient. A three-leaf
binary tree has one two-leaf child and one singleton child, giving the three
listed cherries. There are no other associations at three leaves. The
UnrankedTree quotient erases child swaps, not associativity or label identity.

The new G3CurrentRootExchangeability derivation establishes full source
raw-field permutation symmetry from the actual choices and input fields.
The forest law is therefore invariant under all permutations of a,b,c.
The action is transitive on Fab,Fac,Fbc and on Tab,Tac,Tbc, while F0 is fixed.
Write their probabilities R,A,A,A,D,D,D. This symmetry is conditional on
the SAME full entering register; no register is averaged or refreshed here.

The observer bridge is explicit in the new UNCOMPILED
G3CurrentRootForestReceiver.lean. full_source_forest_eq_rootForest uses
the existing full_prune and actual ancestor representative invariant.
rootForest_card_eq_liveCard uses treeLeaves: equality of two unranked trees
would make one live representative a leaf in the other's fibre, forcing
the representatives equal. Thus quotienting cannot spuriously reduce the
root count. The named smallerCurrentRootKernel and bigonCurrentKernel inherit
the exchangeability, not just a newly defined alternative output law.

## Actual pair deletion determines Q

Let keep={a,b}. Initialize the actual two-copy source with enteringCode N
(selectedSample sample keep) at the SAME node/register. Source validity is
the original descendant proof restricted to keep. The full/selected initial
view equality needed by actual_cross_carrier_program_law is derived fieldwise:
each kept label is its own ancestor with its singleton leaf tree and input
population; outside keep the selected fields are none; the register is equal.
The lift maps each selected subtype label back to its literal original name.

Consequently the EXISTING actual_cross_carrier_program_law transports the
ENTIRE SAME bigonProgram on these two actual carriers. Its source proof
already handles their DIFFERENT copy-dependent uniformization bounds via
the actual generator/exponential binding; those bounds are not equated.
The actual_small_unranked_label_lift theorem identifies the smaller forest
under that literal original-label injection. It retains original gamma,
rates, calendar/program and SAME conditional register. Independent pulses
use their actual selected-current-owner product transport; COMMON uses its
one stored original bit in both carriers.

The pruned pair forest has TWO roots exactly when a and b belong to different
full forest components. In the seven-state list this event is F0,Fac,Fbc.
It is false at Fab and at every fully resolved T state. Therefore, if Q is
the actual two-root no-loss probability on the independently initialized
pair source, projectivity gives

    Q = R+2A.                                           (1)

This is a selected-pair probability, not the event that an arbitrary three-
root source suffers no merger. R is instead that three-root no-loss event.

Normalization on the actual complete seven-state support gives

    R+3A+3D=1.                                         (2)

Solving (1)--(2), with no target kernel assumption, yields

    A=(Q-R)/2,
    D=(2-3Q+R)/6.                                     (3)

The nonnegative actual PMF already enforces R>=0,Q>=R,2-3Q+R>=0.
These necessary row inequalities do not identify the whole attainable
source domain or give a global word bound.

## Q,R from the actual bigon theorem

DotG34.OriginalBigonProgramDiagonal.actual_original_bigon_independent
computes the actual no-loss event for arbitrary n current roots at this
hybrid. It includes the real duration and BOTH actual exits. On the literal
entering n-root Code, AtNode is the full n-element current-root carrier and
liveCard is n. Substituting n=2 and n=3 gives, on the SAME p,x,y:

    QI=p^2*x+(1-p)^2*y+2p(1-p),
    RI=p^3*x^3+(1-p)^3*y^3
         +3p^2(1-p)*x+3p(1-p)^2*y.                    (4)

The n=3 diagonal is exactly the F0 probability, since three disjoint
nonempty blocks on three labels are the three singleton leaves. The n=2
diagonal is exactly the selected-pair probability in (1). Thus (3)--(4)
identify the full independent three-root forest row of the actual original
fragment, not only its scalar coordinates.

The original actual_original_bigon_common is CONDITIONAL on the entering
register bit. It gives

    bit=false: Q=x, R=x^3;
    bit=true:  Q=y, R=y^3.                            (5)

The gamma argument in common=true does not itself draw a bit. For a natural
bank whose SAME entering unused original bit has P(false)=p, P(true)=1-p,
averaging ONCE gives

    QC=p*x+(1-p)*y,
    RC=p*x^3+(1-p)*y^3.                              (6)

Since every entry in (3) is affine in Q,R, this once-averaged full forest row
is the row with (QC,RC). The Bernoulli prior/freshness and legal exterior
blindness are actual separate source obligations, addressed by the earlier
whole-unused-bank/restore/exterior-erasure receivers. A generic exterior may
read the retained bit, in which case the correct output is the conditional
row with that SAME bit, not an averaged replacement.

## All seven input rows and bookend

Use the order F0,Fab,Fac,Fbc,Tab,Tac,Tbc. For arbitrary Q,R from the relevant
actual conditional or admitted natural branch, the COMPLETE seven-state
matrix is

| From / to |F0|Fab|Fac|Fbc|Tab|Tac|Tbc|
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
|F0|R|(Q-R)/2|(Q-R)/2|(Q-R)/2|(2-3Q+R)/6|(2-3Q+R)/6|(2-3Q+R)/6|
|Fab|0|Q|0|0|1-Q|0|0|
|Fac|0|0|Q|0|0|1-Q|0|
|Fbc|0|0|0|Q|0|0|1-Q|
|Tab|0|0|0|0|1|0|0|
|Tac|0|0|0|0|0|1|0|
|Tbc|0|0|0|0|0|0|1|

For Fab input, the actual current-root reconstruction keeps its already
formed ab tree as ONE opaque root and c as the other. Its actual two-root
forest has probability Q of staying separate and 1-Q of joining; the
EXISTING complete graft law produces Fab or Tab respectively. Fac/Fbc are
the same argument with their literal input opaque trees. Each T input has
one current root, an empty actual pair catalogue, and its whole tree is
retained. No descendant is independently recoined and no earlier cherry is
erased. This is the full current-root matrix, not seven independent fits.

actual_nonroot_bigon_exit_population proves every live output is at the
ONE original upper NODE B.upper for BOTH modes. Therefore the forest can
be returned to its original rootward interface; the outside source need not
guess which arm a surviving root occupies. No ancestral completion is
silently appended: B.upper is nonroot, and actual future remains separate.

For compatible actual bookended words, the elementary matrix identity is

    M(Q1,R1) M(Q2,R2)=M(Q1*Q2,R1*R2).

For example, each pair-forest entry is
R1*(Q2-R2)/2+(Q1-R1)*Q2/2=(Q1Q2-R1R2)/2; the resolved entries then follow
from row normalization. This algebra does not identify an arbitrary full-

# Actual original-copy and current-root exchangeability candidate

Existing G3 owner,22October2026. HAND source derivation and implemented Lean
proof candidates, **UNCOMPILED**. No native/hosted check, complete type output,
selected axiom output, object custody or original G3/G4 closure is claimed.
The four authored files below are outside local Git. No worker or job ran.

## Concrete supplied boundary

For the SAME original N, positive rates r, literal chronological ops and
register, let c be the EXISTING enteringCode at one original population place.
For every permutation e of its CURRENT-root carrier, the candidate derives

    (sourceProgram N r ops c).map(fun d => copySnapshot e d.val)
      = (sourceProgram N r ops c).map Subtype.val.

This is full raw Snapshot output-law symmetry, not symmetry of a fitted
finite matrix. Its forest corollary uses the existing child-swap-only rooted
UnrankedTree quotient and rootForest. It derives

    (enteringForestKernel N sample place descendant r ops register)
        .map(copyForest e)
      = enteringForestKernel N sample place descendant r ops register.

The declaration actual_current_root_raw_exchangeable specializes to the
EXISTING actualCurrentRootCode N s place hplace. Its root carrier is
SelectedCopy(state s).live, and hplace concerns precisely those current roots.
No all-full-Code-at-input premise or cap on carried descendant labels is added.
The existing actual_current_roots_complete_graft_law remains the original
opaque-graft receiver. These new candidates do not replace it with a model.

The more general actual_program_raw_copy_to_sample has two finite carriers
A,B, a genuine bijection e:A≃B and two actually valid input Codes. It requires
copySnapshot e sA.val=sB.val, not equality of their sample functions. The
literal enteringCode constructors derive that input equality. Thus arbitrary
different natural tip initializers are NOT declared equal. The same reasoning
covers the supplied finite ancestral completion budget.

These hashes freeze revision1. A later correction needs an explicit revision;
do not silently alter a handed-off file. The lexical source read found no
axiom declaration, sorry/admit placeholder or unsafe token. That is only a
lexical check; #print axioms text is not an executed axiom audit.

G3OriginalCopyEquivalence constructs the direct bijection on ALL literal
Snapshot fields. In particular, dead genealogy/population options are retained.
AdmittedSnapshot only requires decoded source validity; it does not require
these dead options to be absent. Therefore decode followed by admittedCode
cannot serve as the inverse on all raw Codes. SourceValid is reconstructed
using sampleB(b)=sampleA(e.symm b), the SAME original locations and the
actual mapLabels leaf-fibre/well-labelled proofs.

The actual Choice bijection keeps its original Option E population occurrence
and maps BOTH ordered operands. Each half-rate is unchanged. Finite sum
reindexing gives equal total rates; Fintype.card_congr gives the SAME global
uniformization clock. A real merger keeps the first actual representative,
grafts the actual earlier trees, and re-encodes/normalizes dead fields on BOTH
sides. The dummy none branch retains the existing raw Code. The proofs target
the actual choice PMF, step, every natural iteration and Poisson time kernel.

G3OriginalSampleParametricity compares two ACTUALLY valid Codes with identical
raw Snapshot on two sample charts. Actual ordered-pair, current-AtNode coin,
Poisson count and embedded real-jump domains are literally identical. The
actual operations inspect samples only in SourceValid proofs. The candidate
couples those literal choices and proves raw-output equality for actual
boundaries/words, finite endpoint histories and ancestral completion. Its
continuation premise is ordinary extensionality on equal raw fields, not an
assumed target kernel equation. This comparison is the missing extra step
between cross-sample relabelling and within-sample exchangeability.

G3OriginalCopyBoundary maps the ACTUAL AtNode live-owner subtype, retaining
one independent Bernoulli coin per CURRENT owner. Existing Pi-measure
reindexing supplies the full currentCoinPMF map. The deterministic pulse is
derived from its actual dependent membership branch. COMMON reads the SAME
original register bit; the constant function is reindexed, never refreshed.
Actual exit/ordinary/root boundaries, arbitrary literal original words,
existing finite endpoint histories and real-jump completion then compose.
The original endpoint order, vertices, edge occurrences and gamma convention
are unchanged. No arbitrary source operation reordering is performed.

G3CurrentRootExchangeability composes the preceding maps. It checks the
fields of EXISTING enteringState/enteringCode, whose all-live singleton
forest is permutation-invariant at the same original place/register.
It specializes that raw symmetry to EXISTING actualCurrentRootCode and
derives the complete rootForest quotient law by actual leaf substitution.

## Precise remaining work

The candidate supplies the source-label symmetry derivation, not the full
canonical numerical matrix. At cap3, combine its actual rooted-forest law

# Actual outside-cohort and completed-future private-register erasure

Authored22October2026UTC by the existing G3 owner. HAND source-specific
proofs and an UNCOMPILED candidate. The existing source inventory supplies
more than the earlier generic-exterior warning; these exact constructions
do not claim a new kernel pass or original G3 closure.

[G3OriginalExteriorRegisterErasure.lean](G3OriginalExteriorRegisterErasure.lean)
is12127B/SHA256f367a0db1007437b0adc365f2fda3a0cb8ea5880e9acf5296b4975a8933e362f.
No earlier delivered candidate was changed.

## Two different physical use-sites

The outside ORIGINAL descendant-copy carrier has no samples descending from
the private span. Its actual program can therefore traverse the literal
private-node operations with EMPTY current-owner domains there. This gives
a full outside-program erasure theorem even though a syntactic
NoPrivateWordRead check flags those COMMON operators.

The full ORIGINAL copy carrier after the private block does contain those
descendant samples. It uses a different receiver: the literal remaining
calendar has no further private-node reads by the existing physical
age/suffix construction. Its actual ancestral/unranked completion also
ignores private register coordinates. Neither receiver freezes exterior roots
or assumes an arbitrary readout ignores the bank.

## Outside carrier: derive emptiness from actual graph/source validity

For supplied N,P,sample define the PHYSICAL graph condition

    NoPrivateTaxonReach:
      forall v in P, forall original copy x,
        NOT DReach(v,leaf(sample(x))).                   (1)

For ANY source-valid Code s on this sample, a live root l at node v would
have ancestor(l)=l by the actual representative law. Its original_descendant
validity field then gives DReach(v,leaf(sample(l))), contradicting(1).
Thus the actual AtNode(s,v) current-owner type is empty for EVERY private v,
at every intermediate valid Code. No support-invariance or all-full-carrier
colocation assertion is an input. Empty outside copy carriers are included.

The exact COMMON kernel in SourceBoundaryKernels is

    pure(pulseCode H s (constant(s.register(H.hybrid)))).

If that site is private, both the old-bit and erased-bit coin functions have
the SAME EMPTY actual current-owner domain and are equal by function
extensionality. Existing erase_pulseCode then proves boundary erasure.
If the COMMON site is outside P, existing actual_boundary_erasure applies.
All other boundaries and all actual epoch kernels already commute with
erasure unconditionally. Induction over the actual operation word gives

    sourceProgram(ops,s).map(erase)
      = sourceProgram(ops,erase(s))                     (2)

for EVERY word ops on this outside sample. It can contain private COMMON
operators. The outside population/forest evolution remains its ACTUAL
source evolution; no identity or constant outside program is substituted.

The new candidate's exact declarations are actual_private_atNode_empty,
actual_boundary_erasure_of_no_private_taxon_reach and
actual_program_erasure_of_no_private_taxon_reach.

## Derive the graph condition from an existing generated original span

G1OriginalSpanRegion defines nodeRegion and DescendantNeutral. For an
OriginalSpan from a to b, DescendantNeutral states that EACH node in its
literal nodeRegion has exactly a's descendant taxa. It is not true for
arbitrary paths through branching nodes.

The already-existing
G1OriginatedNeutralSpanRegion.actual_originated_bridge_region_neutral
DERIVES this predicate from actual Originated decorated bridge splices.
It is not an abstract neutral-path axiom.

G1OriginalExteriorCohort.originalOutsideCopies is the STATIC original
copy subset with NOT DReach(a,leaf(sample(x))). Consequently, on its actual
selectedSample carrier, every P subset of nodeRegion satisfies(1). This is
neutral_span_outside_no_private_taxon_reach in the candidate, followed by
actual_outside_span_program_erasure. It retains original sample taxa and
the SAME original graph, rather than replacing them by a small reduced core.

The private-site membership P subset nodeRegion remains a literal word/
exporter binding. The existing Originated supplier handles a PROVIDED actual
source. These theorems do not construct fresh Source/Code/Originated witnesses
for a returned algebraic parameter tuple.

## Actual completed-tree kernel, with no arbitrary finish premise

SourceEmbeddedJumpLaw defines the actual ancestral jump mass from the
unchanged current pair catalogue and rates: absorb at zero total rate,
otherwise use each current pair-rate fraction. PrivateRegisterSourceStep
already supplies unchanged catalogue/destination commutation under erasure;
PrivateRegisterErasure supplies equal choiceRate and totalRate. Hence its
ACTUAL sourceJumpStep commutes with register erasure, including zero-rate
absorption.

SourceAncestralCompletion's ancestralCompletion is finite iteration of these
literal jumps. Induction gives its erasure equation at every jump budget.
The actual sourceUnrankedForest readout uses genealogy/ancestor fields,
which erasure leaves definitionally unchanged. Define

    F(s) = ancestralCompletion(N,r,card(Copy),s)
             .map(sourceUnrankedForest(full original copies)).

Then the new source-level proof gives F(s)=F(erase(s)). This F is precisely
the completion/readout kernel occurring in naturalCompletedUnrankedLaw,
whose actual source definition and complete support theorem were read.
No chosen hidden-bit observer is substituted. Actual natural calendar root
arrival and the one-complete-tree support remain the inherited theorems;
the erasure identity itself does not require a new root-arrival premise.
Empty Copy is allowed for the identity; the one-tree support theorem retains
its own Nonempty Copy premise.

These are actual_jump_erasure, actual_ancestral_completion_erasure and
actual_completed_unranked_kernel_erasure in the UNCOMPILED candidate.
No continuous-time convergence, literal marked-clock law or cross-genealogy
coupling is added by the finite completion identity.

## Full original future: recover the existing literal calendar supplier

The COMPLETE existing PrivateRegisterCalendar source contains

    actual_calendar_suffix_noPrivateWordRead,
    actual_boundary_and_suffix_noPrivateWordRead,
    actual_guarded_suffix_exists,
    calendarTail_split_after_boundary.

They derive no-read from strict younger-private-node ages and a split of the
ACTUAL sorted original date list; neither the desired no-read word nor a
kernel equation is supplied as a hypothesis. Tied nodes share the complete
guard boundary; edge exits remain before node operations.

The exact originalClosingFuture is MORE specific: remaining upper-date
exits AFTER the last connector, then that date's nodeOperations, then
calendarTail on afterDate. If ALL private nodes are strictly younger than
that upper date, its retained nodes and all later nodes are outside P, and
every retained exit is safe. Thus the existing exclusion-by-date argument
applies to this literal remaining word too. It is not silently identified
with the full guard boundary, nor are tied exits moved across node entry.
This final partial-exit/calendar call-site specialization is HAND here;
there is no newly elaborated originalClosingFuture theorem in the candidate.

For any future whose actual no-read premise is supplied, equation(2)'s
inherited syntactic counterpart and F(s)=F(erase(s)) give

    sourceProgram(future,s).bind(F)
      = sourceProgram(future,erase(s)).bind(F).          (3)

This is actual_completed_future_erasure. It provides a concrete actual
ancestral/unranked future receiver for the earlier restoration construction.

## What this advances and what remains

The generic contextual graft theorem permits an arbitrary exterior which
could inspect every register bit. That generic quantifier still cannot be
used to average a COMMON kernel. Equations(2),(3) instead derive the needed
blindness for these PARTICULAR actual outside-source and completed-future
consumers. Combined with the once-drawn whole-bank product/restoration, they
remove the need to GUESS that these consumers are private-bit blind.

Their final typed joining through the selected inside/outside graft diagram,
the precise original partial-exit future, and numerical M/Phi/canonical
current-root decoder remain separate composition work. Fresh N'/Code/
BinaryValid/RegistryValid, protected old-ID/menu/calendar/rate/Originated
maps and same p/compiler-gamma physical BOTH bank are also open. General
all-input H, all-core NO and the inherited nonlinear-log zero test remain.

The new Lean candidate is UNCOMPILED, including its exact API proof steps.
Existing source contributor/UNCHECKED headers are retained; raw source
authentication or selected-package provenance is not new elaboration,
native object custody or kernel acceptance. No new build/model/suite job,
held replay, local Git or worker action was selected.

# Whole unused-bank law at the actual before-node frontier

Authored2026-10-22UTC by the existing G3 owner. Original source recovery and
an UNCOMPILED composition. No new execution admission or original G3 closure.

## The inherited supplier is already whole-bank, not just one bit

I read the COMPLETE pinned ActualUnusedSeedConditioning source458bb5f...
and its original dependencies. actual_unused_seed_event_mass and
actual_unused_seed_posterior quantify over

    A : Set (PrivateHybrid N P -> Bool).

They therefore cover an arbitrary event of the ENTIRE original private
register bank. No induction from separate single-bit marginals, independent
posterior assumption or refreshed coin is required. The exact requirement
is NoPrivateWordRead N P ops on the literal original source operation word.
The bit-posterior corollary is narrower than this existing whole-bank theorem.
This corrects the insufficient single-bit navigation emphasis in my earlier
continuation; it is not a new theorem or a claim that the contributor supplied
only single-bit independence.

PrivateSeedHistoryFactorization8bba9735... has the still more direct PMF
equality actual_private_seed_erased_history_product:

    actual naturally initialized source history, mapped to
       (original private bank, SAME erased initial Code/endpoint vector)
      = independentPMF (privateSeedPMF N P p)
          (initializedEndpointLaw N r ops (outsideInitialCodeLaw N P sample p)).

This product is DERIVED from the actual original hybrid product and admitted
initializer, using actual no-read history transport. The first component is
the same bank drawn at initialization. Erasure changes only private register
coordinates: live roots, owner/ancestor, genealogy and population/location
fields remain, and outside original register coordinates remain. The old
actual_private_seed_erased_history_readout already permits one joint internal
deterministic readout. Choosing a readout does not authorize it biologically.

All original contributor/status headers, including their UNCHECKED historical
component labels, remain controlling. Selected-package provenance is not
a new component elaboration, object-custody or kernel receipt by me.

## Exact cut-position mismatch addressed by the new source candidate

The existing PrivateRegisterCalendarPrefix9f50ff8c... supplies no-read for
the literal sorted initial compiler prefix THROUGH a lower guard's entire
boundary, when all private node ages are strictly above it. The G3/G4
node-panel receiver instead uses actualFrontierProgram: it processes every
exit tied to the input date and stops BEFORE that date's node-entry batch.
These lists are different and cannot be silently identified.

G3ActualFrontierUnusedBank.lean8221B/SHA256
86aaa278deb7cf1dbcb512161ca5c64f3030d7b36147507eb03be954dd6363b8
is the new UNCOMPILED candidate binding the latter precise list. It:

- proves no-read for stopBeforeTail by induction over the actual ordered
  date list containing the selected stop; every earlier processed boundary
  is at most the stop date;
- derives beforeBoundaryProgram no-read from sortedOriginalDates and the
  actual scheduled node date;
- appends the SAME tied exit list, whose operations do not read registers,
  deriving actualFrontierProgram_noRead from the physical inequality
  C.age input < C.age privateNode for every private node;
- applies the inherited whole-bank PMF product to this actual frontier;
- derives a stochastic continuation form by PMF.bind_map, preserving the
  same whole-bank/erased-history joint law instead of replacing its marginals.

No desired probability law, initial independence, all-full-Code colocation,
new clock or target M is a premise. The strict private-age requirement is an
actual source/calendar use-site condition. It is not obtained from a raw
Code validator flag or guessed from a smaller reduced core.

The natural initializer takes HybridProbabilities p, while the compiler also
accepts gamma for original INDEPENDENT pulses. This invariant is valid for
those supplied arguments, but a single physical BOTH application still has
to instantiate their SAME original bank as in the existing bank receiver.
The invariant itself does not certify that a caller chose matching tuples.

## What the product law does not justify

smallerCurrentRootKernel and the contextual graft theorem condition on the
full entering register. COMMON at that fixed register remains a deterministic
choice of each original arm; it is not the natural averaged M(C,D).

To use the numerical COMMON kernel, the legal exterior/readout must ignore
the fresh private register coordinates, the same actual entering case must
be retained, and the original bank must be integrated ONCE through the
future kernel. An arbitrary exterior in the generic contextual theorem can
inspect the full register and cannot discharge that erasure requirement.
The new arbitrary stochastic K theorem is an internal bind interface, not
a proof that K is an admitted original observation or the actual future word.
Reconstructing its real post-prefix source continuation remains a supplier.

The existing unranked suppliers were also read completely:

    G1UnrankedActualGenerator70f7f499...
    G1UnrankedNaturalPulse71e60636...
    G1ActualOriginalUnrankedLocalKernel49b2b32f...

actual_unranked_step_row_independent is a full original-source step PMF map
on the SAME unranked clade/population/register view. The pulse source proves
the actual current-block coin-product reindexing. originalLocalRow and
actual_original_local_word_composition give actual source-derived full rows
and finite-word composition, retaining the original graph/rates/register.
They are not the new seven-state numerical M or G4's marked Phi. Equality
after erasing implementation representatives is also not, by itself, the
full current-root LABEL permutation symmetry needed for that identification.

The next source binder remains the actual first node entry/own-edge
exposure/pulse/exit and canonical current-root forest decoding, followed by
the legal private-register-erased future/readout. The fresh N'/original
Code/BinaryValid/RegistryValid, old ID/menu/calendar/rate/Originated diagrams

# Supplied affine-log points cannot cross the hyperplane theorem's bound

22 October2026. HAND candidate, self-audited, unreviewed and uncompiled.
No original G3 endpoint or historical-priority claim. No new mathematical
producer, numerical experiment, source/compiler/QE/model/native run.

## 1. Exact remaining construction and prior comparison

The original all-input G3 recognizer still needs exact strict-source selection
and terminating NO, including nonattained closure contacts. Its retained
COMMON promise reduction leaves a possible algebraic-input pure branch

    ell_i=a*T_i(r),  r transcendental, a!=0,
    i in{3,6,10,15,21},
    T_i(X)=sum_(j=0)^(i-2)(i-1-j)X^j.

Write K=Qbar, V=span_K{T_3(r),T_6(r),T_10(r),T_15(r),T_21(r)},
and W=K+a*V. If the five exponentials are algebraic, W is a known
subspace of the extended algebraic-logarithm space Le.

The complete closest predecessor G3-SPARSE-LOG-ROUTE.md,19160B/SHA256
6c6378ce83e0116a424c825cae82ac436e17f1ff1147f325805efea959bb7d9b,
already proves the affine2-by-3 rank-one obstruction. Its later point-count
section bounds ALL normals drawn from the original V, including exceptional
scale values. It explicitly leaves normals outside that span uncovered.
Those old proofs and the exact cubic-independence certificate are REUSED.

The complete later METHOD-ADMISSION-UNREVIEWED.md at Commons
8b96f4fbb6ee0a19a0b20dd86f8a798ee4c96dd6,
research/2026-10-22-dot-g3-transcendence-admission-0557z,
18072B/SHA2566eaf35d5af52cf7b86b0e24d02c32bd3d999a6c24d2080f091ca42f37bddee13,
was also read. Its remaining homogeneous matrix-pencil target is already
screened by G3-FIVE-LOG-ALL-RANK-SCREEN.md. That ordinary-logarithm theorem
has a different entry-admission contract; it does not by itself replace the
arbitrary-normal affine calculation below.

**New claim relative to these inspected suppliers:** the same point bound
holds for EVERY complex hyperplane with no nonzero K-vector, even when its
normal is outside the supplied log span and outside K(r,a). This removes
that entire specific point-construction route, rather than trying another
normal or another dimension. No exhaustive literature-absence claim is made.

The receiver is [Waldschmidt, Variations on the Six Exponentials Theorem,
Theorem3.1](https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~michel.waldschmidt/articles/pdf/Hyderabad.pdf#page=11):
for H a hyperplane with H intersect K^d={0}, the K-dimension of H intersect
Le^d is at most d(d-1). A contradiction needs MORE qualifying independent
points. Theorem3.1 and Corollary3.2 were read at their actual hypotheses;
no missing points or closure under multiplication is supplied by them.

## 2. Candidate theorem

For ANY nonzero complex a and transcendental complex r, form V,W as above.
For EVERY complex hyperplane H subset C^d with H intersect K^d={0},

    dim_K(H intersect W^d) <= d(d+1)/2,       d>=3.          (1)

For d=2 the dimension is at most2; for d=1 it is0.
Consequently, in every dimension the supplied W-points cannot exceed
d(d-1), the strict threshold needed at this receiver. The theorem does not
assume that a and r are algebraically independent or that a is rational in r.

## 3. A valuation with one-dimensional residue

Let F=K(r,a). On F, and then on F(Z) for a NEW FORMAL indeterminate Z,
choose a valuation trivial on K, with residue field EXACTLY K and v(r)<0.
Here valuations are algebraic proof devices, not physical source limits.

The construction includes both possible scale cases:

* If a is algebraic over K(r), extend the infinity valuation of K(r) to
  the finite extension F. Such an extension exists by a dominating valuation
  ring. Its residue is finite algebraic over K and hence equals K.
* If a is transcendental over K(r), F is the rational function field
  K(r)(a). Compose the a-adic valuation with the infinity valuation of
  its residue field K(r). This has a lexicographically ordered value group,
  residue K and v(r)<0.

In either case extend to F(Z) by composing the Z-adic valuation with the
chosen valuation on its residue F. Again the residue is K and v(r)<0.
No specialization of Z to a physical parameter, algebraic logarithm or
actual observation is used.

The reused existence and finite-residue facts are
[Stacks, Lemma10.50.2](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/00I8),
[Lemma15.125.2](https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0ASH), and the composition
construction in Lemma10.50.10. Their selected statements were actually read.

For a finite-dimensional K-subspace U of this valued field, a basis can
be chosen with pairwise DISTINCT values. To see this, take a nonzero vector
of least value among any finite basis. All vectors of U have value at least
that minimum. Dividing by the chosen vector and taking residue defines a
nonzero K-linear map U->K. Its kernel has codimension1 and strictly larger
values. Repeat on that kernel. This terminates after dim U steps.

In particular nonzero K-linear combinations of distinct-value basis
vectors have the least value of their nonzero terms; cancellation is
impossible. This argument also works for the lexicographic value groups
above and does not assume a discrete rank-one valuation.

## 4. Product dimension from the OLD Sidon degree list

Set E={1,4,8,13,19}, the degrees of the five T_i. Their ten positive
differences3,4,5,6,7,9,11,12,15,18 are all different. This finite list and
its polynomial-space consequences were already verified in the predecessor;
no new degree producer is run here.

Because v(r)<0 and all nonzero K-coefficients have value0,

    v(T_i(r))=deg(T_i)*v(r).

The five values form a Sidon set E_v in the ordered value group: every
nonzero ordered difference occurs at most once. The group is torsion-free,
so multiplication of the distinct integer differences by v(r)!=0 preserves
their distinctness.

Take ANY d-dimensional K-subspace U of F(Z), with distinct-value basis
u_1,...,u_d and value set D. Each pair of different translates

    v(u_i)+E_v,   v(u_j)+E_v

has at most one intersection. Otherwise E_v would have two representations
of the same nonzero ordered difference. Inclusion-exclusion therefore gives

    |D+E_v| >= 5d-binom(d,2).

Choose one product u_j*T_i(r) for each distinct value in this union. Those
products are K-linearly independent by their distinct values. Thus

    dim_K(U*V) >= 5d-binom(d,2).                            (2)

The bound is valid for EVERY U, not only U subset V. It remains a valid
lower bound when its right side is small or negative at large d.

## 5. Descent of an arbitrary actual hyperplane

The original H may have a normal outside F. It cannot simply be assumed
to have a rational-function normal. Here is the exact reduction needed.

Let z_1,...,z_l be a K-basis of P=H intersect W^d. This space is finite
dimensional because dim_K W<=6. Let S be their F-linear span in F^d.
Since their actual complex span lies in H,

    S intersect K^d={0},    dim_F S=q<=d-1.                (3)

Choose an F-linear quotient map pi:F^d->F^k with kernel S, k=d-q>=1.
Denote its coordinate rows by pi_0,...,pi_(k-1). Define the row vector

    n = sum_(i=0)^(k-1) Z^i*pi_i  in F(Z)^d.

It annihilates every z_j. Its coordinates n_1,...,n_d are K-linearly
independent: for any nonzero c in K^d, (3) implies pi(c)!=0, so
sum Z^i*pi_i(c) is a NONZERO polynomial in the formal Z. Therefore n*c!=0.

This constructs a suitable normal in F(Z) without specializing a generic
complex number or presuming that the initial H was defined over F. The
K-linear independence of the old z_j is unchanged in this formal field.
Only the annihilating row has been extended; their supplied W-entries stay
the original entries.

## 6. Rank-nullity gives the uniform bound

Let U=span_K{n_1,...,n_d}, which has dimension d. The image of the K-linear
map n:W^d->F(Z) is

    U+a*(U*V).

Its dimension is at least dim(U*V), because a!=0. By(2), rank-nullity and
dim W<=6 give

    l <= dim_K ker(n|W^d)
      <= 6d-[5d-binom(d,2)]
       = d+binom(d,2)=d(d+1)/2.

This proves(1) for d>=3, including algebraically dependent scales and
arbitrary original normals. In fact this particular bound holds for every
d, but d=2 needs the sharper reused statement below.

For d=2, three independent W-points on H would be columns of a rank-one
2-by-3 matrix. The rows would also be K-linearly independent, since a
nonzero H with a K-dependent line direction would contain a nonzero
K-vector. If 1 is not in aV, the predecessor's complete affine2-by-3 proof
excludes this. If 1 is in aV instead, W=aV and its earlier homogeneous
polynomial-space lemma already excludes even a nontrivial2-by-2 rectangle.
Thus the dimension is at most2 in both cases. For d=1, H={0}.

For d>=3,

    d(d+1)/2 <= d(d-1).

Hence NO dimension and NO hyperplane normal permits more than the
theorem's d(d-1) qualifying W-points. The cases d=1,2 obey the same final
threshold. This does not invoke a transcendence conjecture or promote a
matrix-coefficient conjecture to a theorem.

## 7. Changed frontier and exact limits

The predecessor's arbitrary-normal gap for THIS hyperplane point receiver
is removed by the candidate proof. Do not restart its search by moving the
normal outside the original five-log span, increasing d, or choosing a
special algebraic/rational-function scale. The old normal-in-V calculation
and affine2-by-3 result remain credited special cases, not new discoveries.

This does NOT exclude a theorem with different hypotheses/conclusions,
additional Le-elements independently supplied outside W, mixed additive/
multiplicative-group statements with different point counts, or nonlinear
arithmetic information. A product of known logs is not automatically a new
Le-element. The bound does not prove that the hypothetical rank-five pure
algebraic input exists or that it is impossible.

Original G3 still needs total exact strict-source recognition and all-size
NO, including the actual calibrated logarithmic-purity gate and other cores/
coupled fibres. This is a uniform method screen, NOT that completion.
No physical word, known target, new source observable or G4 endpoint was
constructed. The proof is HAND/self-audited, not independently accepted or
formally verified. Standard valuation facts and all inherited finite checks
are reused, with no identical rerun or extra proof/review worker.

## 2. ONE actual source sequence and ONE finite algebraic input

Fix b=1-2^(-175), r=1/2, and L=-log b>0. For every N>=1 set

    u_N=b^(1/(2N+1)), t_N=b^(1/N),
    p_N=2(1-t_N).

Here p_N is the MINORITY/parent1 probability. Original parent0 has weight
1-p_N; native gamma=p_N. Every occurrence has a distinct fresh ID/bit.
All parameters are algebraic and strictly between0 and1: b>1/2 and
t_N>=b imply0<p_N<1. Define the literal positive A-pendant word

    W_N=E(u_N)[B(u_N,u_N/2,parent0=1-p_N)E(u_N)]^N.       (1)

The power means N distinct physical cells, not reuse of one exposed bit.
Use the fixed positive tree((A,B),(C,D)); put W_N on A's eligible pendant
slot and give every other finite edge survival1/2. Retain the original root,
all four taxa and the same outside fields. The inherited bridge insertion
constructs one finite admitted original source T_N for BOTH mechanisms.
It does not expose the private forest or add a source-size promise.

The COMMON survival moments of its A word are exactly

    m_lambda^(N)=b^lambda[1-p_N+p_N*2^(-lambda)]^N.        (2)

In particular m_1^(N)=b^2 EXACTLY. As N tends to infinity they converge to
the OLD nonattained algebraic tuple

    m_lambda=b^(lambda+2-2^(1-lambda)),
    lambda in{1,3,6,10,15,21}.                            (3)

The old compact encoding uses successive positive square roots of b; no
numerical logarithm equality is an input oracle.

Let y_C be its old eight-row original calibrated profile: six A-monophyly
rows with allocations A:k,B:1,C:1,D:1 for k=2,...,7, followed by the two

Complements are the other binary outcomes. The last probabilities are
2/3 and25/48. The first six are the OLD rational triangular transform F(m).

For an explicit finite formula for those coordinates, put lambda_j=j(j-1)/2,
m_0=1, and use the inherited ordinary death polynomials

       *sum_(h=j)^k x^(lambda_h)
          /product_(ell=j,ell!=h)^k(lambda_ell-lambda_h).

Then F_k(m) is the same linear combination of m_(lambda_h) obtained from

Let T_b be the SAME ordinary outside tree, replacing the entire A word by

## 3. Full I forest convergence with one physical tuple

All distances in this section are total variation, sup-over-events convention,
uniform over entering labelled forests with at most M CURRENT roots. Old
subtrees remain opaque. Set h_N=-log u_N=L/(2N+1).

For a bare actual I bigon B, put e=1-b_2(B). The REUSED estimate is

    TV(B,E(b_2(B)))<=D_M e^(3/2),
    D_M=2binom(M,2)[(3/2)binom(M,3)+27binom(M,4)].

It applies to the FULL labelled forest, with opaque grafting and two-sided
stochastic contraction. It is not a count-only or diagonal bound. For our
bare B_N, the exact pair formula(8) gives

    e_N<=1-u_N+p_N^2/2
       <=L/(2N)+2L^2/N^2=O(1/N).

Replace each bare B_N by its pair-matched ordinary E(b_2(B_N)), in its
ORIGINAL place; retain the old leading edge and every connector. The
ordinary replacements compose to E(Q_N), where Q_N is the ACTUAL full
I pair in(9). Thus the old estimate gives

    TV(I(W_N),E(Q_N))<=D_M*N*e_N^(3/2)=O(N^(-1/2)).     (6)

Equation(9), p_N=O(1/N) and1/u_N-1=O(1/N) imply Q_N->b. The ordinary
finite-cap kernel is polynomial in its survival, hence continuous. Therefore

    TV(I(W_N),E(b))->0.                                (7)

No new weak-factor theorem is required. Grafting the same original exterior/
root and applying any declared finite observation cannot increase distance.
One T_N converges on the ENTIRE fixed I panel J, with its original allocations
and one tuple. No global calendar epoch is interchanged and no outside program
is frozen. The inherited unranked source/grafting interface is essential.

The sequence is coherent across caps: for each fixed finite M,(7) tends
to0. This is not convergence uniform over all unbounded M and is not exact

## 4. The cross-arm term is necessary; exact I equality is NOT supplied

The actual arm-level I pair survival is

    q_arm=(1-p)^2*u+p^2*(u/2)+2p(1-p)
         =u+2p(1-p)(1-u)-u*p^2/2.                       (8)

It is NOT u*(1-p^2/2): split pairs have no arm merger and do not acquire
the factor u. Omitting the positive cross-arm term falsifies the pair
calculation; a collision-only direct comparison can also fail. That factoring
was rejected during the source audit before using it in a theorem.

For(1), its actual whole-word pair is

    Q_N=b[1+2p_N(1-p_N)(1/u_N-1)-p_N^2/2]^N.            (9)

In fact Q_N<b at EVERY finite N. Let u=u_N,t=t_N,p=p_N and let delta be
the nonconstant bracket part in(9). Then

    u*delta/p=(4-3u)t-(2-u),
    t=u^(2+1/N)<u^2,
    2-u-u^2(4-3u)=(1-u)^2(3u+2)>0.

Thus delta<0, while1+delta=q_arm/u>0. The original I row in(5) therefore
differs from T_N's row for EVERY N: the latter is1-(2/3)Q_N>y_I.

This explicit guard prevents interpreting an approximate family as a G4
exact-rival family. No finite T_N fits the target's I pair even though its
entire I forest law converges to the ordinary law.

The old B calibrators stay exact at every N. Hence z_J belongs to the
ACTUAL SAME-tuple original response closure and has distance zero from it.
Every requested finite natural I panel has such an extension of the SAME

Consequently the paired positive-distance NO branch in

# Literal original-Code boundary for canonical current-root labels

Authored22October2026UTC, existing G3 owner. HAND carrier construction and
precise remaining row suppliers, not a new typed kernel, numerical receiver,
compiler pass or G3 completion. No new model/build/review job is selected.

## Read the actual carrier before defining a bijection

The COMPLETE FiniteSourceSnapshot source4628112b... was read at1138a5 and
raw-SHA256/Gitblob authenticated. A Snapshot has exactly

    live : Finset Copy
    ancestor : Copy -> Copy
    genealogy : Copy -> Option (WellLabelledTree Copy)
    population : Copy -> Option (Location V E)
    register : V -> Bool.

Code is the subtype whose DECODED state is SourceValid for the original N
and sample. It does not require absent genealogy/population at dead slots.
encodeSnapshot does clear those dead slots. Therefore decoding and then
applying admittedCode need not recover an arbitrary original raw Code.
Two valid snapshots differing only in a dead slot are a literal witness to
the issue: their live-source validity conditions are identical, but both
re-encode with that dead slot absent. This is a field-level HAND observation,
not a newly executed counterexample or an objection to actual endpoint laws.

This rules out a proposed shortcut which would assert an all-Code inverse
for relabelling through admittedCode without either normalization evidence
or a direct snapshot map. Actual initialized destinations do normalize as
their existing definitions specify; that does not normalize every subtype
element by definition.

## Direct carrier transport, preserving every raw field

Let e:A equiv B be a bijection of finite COPY labels. The original graph
N, taxa X, original node/edge/hybrid IDs, ordered parent registry, dates,
rates and original register coordinates stay fixed. Define

    sampleB(b)=sampleA(e.inverse(b)).

Existing SourceCopyCarrierTransport.mapLabels preserves genealogy shape and
maps each leaf through e. Its mapLabels_wellLabelled theorem constructs the
target WellLabelledTree. Relabel each snapshot s directly:

    liveB = image(e,liveA)
    ancestorB(b) = e(ancestorA(e.inverse(b)))
    genealogyB(b) = Option.map(mapWellLabelledTree(e),
                               genealogyA(e.inverse(b)))
    populationB(b) = populationA(e.inverse(b))
    registerB = registerA.                              (1)

This also transports DEAD optional fields, preserving their information.
No canonical ordering or replacement graph is chosen.

The decoded genealogy commutes with mapLabels, including a missing option:
its fallback leaf b equals mapLabels(e,leaf(e.inverse(b))). The decoded
location likewise commutes, including its missing-option fallback at the
UNCHANGED original root. Ancestry and live fields commute literally.

SourceValid for sampleB follows field by field. Ancestor-live and live
representative use the live image and inverse identities. The leaf-fibre
condition uses the existing mapLabels_leaves image equation; well-labelled
live trees use mapLabels_wellLabelled. Each original_descendant condition
is exactly the old condition at e.inverse(b), because its actual original
population and taxon are unchanged. Thus(1) constructs a valid Code on the
reindexed sample. No desired source kernel is a validity premise.

Applying(1) with e.inverse is the inverse on ALL raw snapshots and valid
Codes. Genealogy composition/identity follows by induction on the original
binary tree, Option.map composition then handles every slot. Other fields
cancel by the bijection identities; subtype proofs cancel by proof
irrelevance. This is a concrete HAND carrier isomorphism. Its Lean
implementation and full selected type/axiom evidence are not supplied here.

## Exact stochastic row suppliers still needed

Carrier isomorphism alone is not a source-kernel or exchangeability proof.
The following row-level transports must be established against actual
definitions, then composed through the actual finite word:

1. The current ordered pair catalogue maps (population,i,j) to
   (SAME original population,e(i),e(j)). Each actual pair rate and total
   rate must agree. The holding normalization must use the same cardinality
   via card(A)=card(B), retaining the actual clock; no rescaled clock is
   inferred from a relabelling. Actual merger destinations must commute.
2. Exit/ordinary/root operations retain the SAME original edges/nodes.
   AtNode current owners map through e. INDEPENDENT pulse coin products
   transport by that finite-index equivalence; COMMON retains the SAME
   original register bit. G2LiveLineageRouting's actual current-owner rule
   remains controlling: never replace a live-token coin with per-leaf coins.
3. Lift the actual step/boundary relations to Poisson time kernels and
   sourceProgram, preserving every original ordered operation and rate.
   Existing G2 history_projection can then transport the actual finite
   endpoint vector, but does not supply a literal marked-clock record.

These transports have a direct proof plan from the inspected definitions;
they are not advertised as existing declarations or checked equations.

There is also a separate SAMPLE issue. The carrier map above changes the
sample function by precomposition. A permutation of labels is not a theorem
that an arbitrary fixed tip assignment has a permutation-invariant law.
For the all-colocated current-root initializer, the reindexed sample has the
same admitted raw snapshot, but a same-raw-snapshot/same-graph row comparison
across those two valid sample charts still has to be proved. Actual row
definitions use sample in validity proofs and construct their rates/routing
from live forests/populations, not from an extra taxon-dependent rate; this

## Bind canonical current roots and the seven-state target

For an actual supported cut state, the existing
actual_current_roots_complete_graft_law already passes to its CURRENT
live-root carrier L with opaque original subtrees retained for grafting.
Choose a bijection L equiv Fin(card L), apply(1), and later graft canonical

singleton forests; the3resolved rooted triple trees. Given ACTUAL source

probabilities Q,R would force the full matrix. From all3singletons the row is

    all3singletons: R
    each pair+singleton: (Q-R)/2

Indeed deletion to a chosen pair leaves it separate in the all-singleton

This identifies the next exact formal receiver target without assuming an

documents.body:
> Recovered authored source, 23 October 2026. Current disposition is in the package result catalogue. A completed hand proof is **PROVED (not Lean formalized)** at its stated scope; independent review is a separate field. Historical candidate/open headers below do not reopen a completed component or establish a broader endpoint. This publication is not a new proof or a new execution. Private local addressing/receipt locators are omitted; the original and public hashes and exact projection kinds are recorded in SOURCE-MANIFEST.json.

# Arbitrarily weak three-cell words can require three cells

Authored 2026-10-21. HAND private paired-kernel theorem. All parameters below
can be rational. This refutes the proposed local three-weak-to-two rule;
it does not refute every cost-dependent bound or decide original G3.

Use `G3-CAP3-TWO-CELL-CRITERION.md`, its equal-arm coordinates, and its
closed two-cell envelope `F(z;q,B)`. COMMON equality `C3=C2^3` forces equal
arms in every strict competing fresh private word; competitors' coins remain
free. A bound on the closed envelope therefore excludes every strict
competitor with at most two cells at this interface.

## A concrete exact example

Take three balanced cells with costs

\[
 (u_1,u_2,u_3)=(11/10,11/10,1000001/1000000)
\]

and ordinary bank `A=1-1/10^15`. Put `U0=product u_i`, `c=A/U0` and

\[
 q=882000441/800000000,\qquad
 r=857477286214643107/640000000000000000.
\]

The target is `(c,c^3,cq,c^3r)`. Three strict cells with any positive
ordinary-passage factorization of `A` attain it. Exact Wolfram elimination
found no `z` satisfying the two-cell envelope domain with `F(z;q,1/c)>=r`.
The new solver separately returned `NO_AT_MOST_TWO_PRIVATE_CELLS`.
An additional exact rational check verified `delta<=delta0` and
`L*(U0/A-U0)<g` from the uniform proof below, so the concrete example also
has that analytic certificate with its actual supplied strict bank.
Consequently the private paired minimum is exactly **three**. Neither check
is an all-core lower bound or a new native Lean execution.

## Uniform construction with all three costs arbitrarily close to one

Fix rational `u>1`, write `alpha=(u-1)^2`, and choose `delta>0` below the
explicit bound below. Use balanced cell costs `u,u,1+delta`. Define

\[
 U0=u^2(1+\delta),\quad
 q=(u+1)^2(2+\delta)/8,\quad
 r=(3u^2+1)^2(4+6\delta+3\delta^2)/64.
\]

At first optimize two cells at closed cost `U0`. For `z>=1` put

\[
\begin{aligned}
 D(z)&=1-2u-u^2-z-2uz+3u^2z+2z^2,\\
 E(z)&=1-6u-3u^2-3z-6uz+9u^2z,\\
 H(z)&=2u^2(u+1)^2(3z^2+1)-(3u^2+1)^2z(z+1).
\end{aligned}
\]

Direct polynomial expansion gives the exact identity

\[
 F(z;q,U0)-r=\frac3{64z(z+1)}
 \left[-(z-u)^2(4D(z)+2\delta E(z))+\delta^2H(z)\right].
\]

The four compact identities used in this proof were all checked exactly
by hosted Wolfram: this identity, the two expansions immediately below,
and the expansion of `H` about `u`. Those checks supplement the HAND bounds.

Writing `v=z-u`, we have

\[
\begin{aligned}
 D(z)&=2\alpha+(3u^2-2u+3)(z-1)+2(z-1)^2\ge2\alpha,\\
 E(z)&=6\alpha-8+3(3u+1)(u-1)(z-1)\ge-8,\\
 H(z)&=-M+H_1v+H_2v^2,
\end{aligned}
\]

where

\[
 M=u(u+1)\alpha(3u^2+1)>0,\quad
 H_2=-3u^4+12u^3-1,\quad
 H_1=2uH_2-(3u^2+1)^2.
\]

Choose any rational `0<delta<=delta0`, where

\[
 \delta_0=\min\left\{\frac\alpha4,\ 1,\
 \frac\alpha{1+|H_2|},\ \frac{2\alpha M}{1+H_1^2}\right\}>0.
\]

These choices give `4D+2delta E>=4alpha`,
`delta^2 |H2|<=alpha`, and `delta^2 H1^2<=2alpha M`.
Young's inequality

\[
 \delta^2 H_1v\le\alpha v^2+\frac{\delta^4H_1^2}{4\alpha}
\]

bounds the braced numerator above by

\[
 -2\alpha v^2-\delta^2M/2<0.
\]

This is a uniform strict exclusion, not a numerical optimizer estimate.

## Restoring strict ordinary passages

Set `Z=2q-1>1`. On the entire possible envelope interval `1<=z<=Z`, the
preceding bound gives the uniform gap

\[
 F(z;q,U0)-r\le-g,\qquad
 g=\frac{3\delta^2M}{128Z(Z+1)}>0.
\]

The envelope is affine in its budget and

\[
 0\le\partial_B F(z;q,B)
 =\frac{3(3z^2+1)}{8z}\left(\frac{2q}{z+1}-1\right)
 \le L=\frac{3(3Z^2+1)(q-1)}8.
\]

Choose rational `epsilon=g/[4(1+L)]`, set `B=U0+epsilon`, `c=1/B` and
`A=U0/B<1`. Then `F(z;q,B)-r<=-g+L epsilon<0` on the entire interval,
including every feasible two-cell envelope point. The supplied three cells
and strict ordinary bank `A` attain `(c,c^3,cq,c^3r)`. Thus their private
paired minimum is exactly three.

For any rational threshold `eta>1`, choose rational `1<u<eta` and then
`0<delta<=delta0` with `delta<eta-1`. Every supplied cost lies in `(1,eta)`.
This proves the arbitrarily weak version with an explicit rational recipe.

## Consequence and limits

A possible upper-bound proof cannot simply delete one cell from every
three-cell block whose arms are sufficiently weak. The exact cost slack and
attainment boundary matter even very near ordinary behavior. This result
does not show unbounded private length at a fixed `c`, does not establish
arbitrarily large weak-cell minima, and does not exclude an input-effective
one-witness bound. Original G3 remains open.

Actual weak-example and factorization receipts:
`[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]` and
`[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`. The final four-zero identity check has
receipt `[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`; the five exact rational
concrete-example checks have receipt `[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`.
`VerifyCap3WeakMinimumThree.wl` contains both reproducible computations.

# A cap-three BOTH word that cannot be compressed to one bigon

21 October 2026. Authored hand argument at the PRIVATE WORD interface.
This is not an all-core original-topology NO instance or an obstruction to
an input-dependent bound. It does not assume hidden coordinates were observed.
General G3 remains OPEN. No independent review or Lean pass is claimed.

## Complete one-bigon criterion on the ordinary COMMON face

Suppose a proposed pair of capped kernels has COMMON pair/triple coordinates
`c,c^3`, with 0<c<1. Let its INDEPENDENT pair/triple coordinates be Q,R.
Set `q=Q/c` and `r=R/c^3`. A strict one-bigon word has positive ordinary
bookend product A<1 and arm survivals x,y with weight 0<p<1. Its COMMON
coordinates satisfy

    c=A*(p*x+(1-p)*y),
    c^3=A^3*(p*x^3+(1-p)*y^3).

Strict convexity of the cube on positive arms forces x=y=s. Put
`u=1/s>1` and `t=p(1-p)`, so 0<t<=1/4. Actual independent current-root
routing then gives

    q = 1+2t(u-1),
    r = 1+3t(u^2-1).

Therefore q>1 and the tuple necessarily has

    u = 2(r-1)/(3(q-1))-1,
    t = (q-1)/(2(u-1)),
    1<u<1/c,  0<t<=1/4.                            (1)

Conversely these inequalities suffice. Set s=1/u,
`p=(1+sqrt(1-4t))/2`, A=c*u, and choose positive bookends
`z=(1+A)/2`, `a=2A/(1+A)`. The actual bare-bigon equations give the
required COMMON and INDEPENDENT pair/triple values. Each complete cap-three
forest kernel is M of its respective two coordinates, so both are matched
by this ONE shared tuple. Thus (1) is an exact bounded one-bigon test,
including strictness. The ordinary zero-bigon case has q=r=1 instead.

This criterion uses the COMMON coordinates to derive a cost restriction;
it does not add an independently observed clock to the input.

## An explicit strict two-bigon witness outside that image

Take the actual legal word

    E(199/200) * BI(1/2,1/2,1/2) * E(397/398)
              * BI(1/2,1/2,1/2) * E(396/397).

All populations and inheritance probabilities are strict. The three ordinary
survivals have product A=99/100. Each equal-arm cell has COMMON kernel
E(1/2) and INDEPENDENT pair/triple values 3/4 and 13/32. Consequently

    c=99/400,              COMMON triple=c^3,
    Q=891/1600,            R=163980531/1024000000,
    q=9/4,                 r=169/16.

The unique one-bigon inverse from (1) is

    u=41/10,  s=10/41,  t=25/124,
    required ordinary bookend product c*u=4059/4000 > 1.

It violates positive ordinary passage strictness. Hence NO one-bigon word
can match these paired cap-three kernels. A zero-bigon word also cannot,
because Q differs from c. The displayed two-bigon word does match them;
its minimum number at this precise private-word interface is exactly two.

This is stronger than showing one chosen I-only representative changes
COMMON: no alternative strict one-bigon tuple can preserve BOTH here.
It does not rule out a universal bound of two or more at cap three, prove
unbounded minimum length, or exclude other original cores/observation fibres.
It shows why the I-only one-bigon theorem cannot simply be reused for BOTH,
even at the same cap and with unexposed natural bits.

Reproducible exact finite controls are in `cap3-both-one-bigon-checks.wl`.
As with the other hand arguments, their returned arithmetic supports the
specified identities; it does not automate the Jensen/source receiver proof.

# Exact cap-three private-word interface and original-source controls

21 October 2026. Research implementation of the proposed hand theorem in
`G3-CAP3-INDEPENDENT-COMPRESSION.md`. Independent review and formal checking
remain pending. Original all-input G3 is OPEN.

## Exact membership, with one auxiliary variable

For a fresh natural INDEPENDENT private bridge with at most three CURRENT
entering roots, the proposed full kernel image is the open strip S in that
proof. Its membership test requires only polynomial real-algebraic predicates.
Let q,r be the proposed pair/triple no-merger coordinates, and define

    D(v)=2+3v-2v^2-2v^3,
    P(v)=3+6v-2v^2-8v^3,
    Aq(v)=q D(v)^2-2(1-v^2)(1+2v)^2,
    Br(v)=r D(v)^3-2v(1+v)^2 P(v).

The exact criterion is the conjunction of:

1. `0<q<1` and `r>0`.
2. `r-3q+2<0 OR (r-3q+2)^2<4(1-q)^3`.
3. `q<=1/2 OR exists v: 0<v, 2v^2<1, Aq(v)=0, Br(v)>0`.

The third condition compares r with the lower boundary using its unique
v parameter; no logarithmic equality or numerical gap is introduced. The
second condition is exactly r<U(q), with its sign branch retained before
squaring. Endpoint equality is excluded because every physical passage
and natural inheritance parameter must stay strict.

This can serve as an internal finite-template solver interface. Each eligible
cap-three slot uses the SAME q,r across all rows, with the full forest matrix
M(q,r) including empty, single, pair and opaque subtree inputs. The retained
core compiler still carries every population and original shared register.
After solving the joint topology equations, reconstruct each slot's strict
word and then one shared physical bank. Slot coordinates are internal
variables, not additional measured outcomes. Templates with an unbounded
higher-cap slot remain outside this branch; failure in the cap-three subset
does not exclude such templates.

## A working exact research prototype

`Cap3PrivateWordCertificate.wl`, SHA256
`70b5118518d5ec7eccb21fb7a2a606f7f99d9aca9d34981c9c524f2705823728`,
defines:

- `Cap3IWordMember[q,r]`: the above exact predicates for real-algebraic inputs.
- `Cap3IWordWitness[q,r]`: a strict positive one-bigon tuple on success;
  `NO_CAP3_WORD_HAND_THEOREM` only at the proposed capped-word scope.
- `Cap3IWordVerify[q,r,tuple]`: direct exact algebraic checks of strictness
  and the supplied tuple's pair/triple identities, independent of compression.

An unresolved library decision produces Failure, never a NO. Inexact inputs
are refused. The source does no file I/O. It is a Wolfram research adapter,
not an integrated native/Rust or all-input original-topology solver.

For ordinary r=q^3, the explicit rational neutral family supplies the arms.
Otherwise choose a rational bookend product A<1 sufficiently close to 1 that
(q/A,r/A^3) stays in S. Solve the fixed bare-bigon two-variable real-algebraic
system, eliminating y by the pair equation. Choose bookends
`z=(1+A)/2`, `a=2A/(1+A)`. Openness proves that this search for A terminates;
the bare image theorem supplies the two-variable system's feasibility.

Actual returned example:

    Cap3IWordWitness[3/8,13/256]
    Leading=3/4, Following=2/3,
    Arm0=1/4, Arm1=5/8, Inheritance=1/3.

Exact substitution returned True. Two rational examples and an algebraic
ordinary target q=sqrt(2)/3 all passed direct strict witness verification.
Ten rational membership controls covered lower/upper endpoint equality,
both sides of each boundary, the low-q branch and known sources. Three
additional algebraic boundary/interior controls returned the expected results.
Inexact input was refused.

The initial algebraic verifier passed an unreduced radical equality to
Resolve. The kernel left it UNRESOLVED with precision messages; the code
correctly returned Failure rather than NO. It was corrected to RootReduce
the algebraic DIFFERENCES before testing zero, and the new check passed.
Initial source/output/failure history: encrypted
`[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`. Corrected full source/output:
`[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`, in the existing featurectl records
directory. The returned static undefined-symbol warnings are retained too.
No numerical tolerance substitutes for equality.

## Fresh execution of the retained ORIGINAL graph compiler

The earlier source/cap-four addendum's statement that no original graph backend
had been run was accurate at its delivery. New execution below supersedes that
execution status only; it does not change the immutable addendum's body.

The complete pinned
[source_checks.py](https://github.com/Sodelin/Research-Commons/blob/07c9a510b594655a62c609a7e354ecfe5752e35f/research/2026-10-01-g4-admitted-testers-0819z/source_checks.py)
was actually read. Its `Source.validate`, `insert_chain` and `compile_source`
operate on actual finite rooted multigraphs, distinct edge/hybrid IDs and
JOINT population/forest histories. Git blob
`64602b8eeb7e1dcc40708e1e98889dd7bc22bf68` and SHA256
`79be4b179572c18acee354b44be4d31aa7d6449bb07579e04f08e56c91077a1b`

# An input-effective word bound on the paired cap-three ordinary face

Authored 2026-10-21. New HAND theorem, not independently reviewed or checked
in Lean. It concerns the fresh private paired cap-three kernel on
`C3=C2^3`; original G3 on arbitrary cores, higher caps and menus remains open.
The proof does not use a source-size or complete-exclusion premise.

## The bound

Use the coordinates of `G3-CAP3-TWO-CELL-CRITERION.md`:

\[
 (C_2,C_3,Q_I,R_I)=(c,c^3,cq,c^3r),\quad 0<c<1,
\]

and physical equal-arm cells `u_i>1`, `0<t_i<=1/4`, ordinary bank `A<1`:

\[
 c=A/\prod u_i,\quad
 q=\prod[1+2t_i(u_i-1)],\quad
 r=\prod[1+3t_i(u_i^2-1)].
\]

Let `B=1/c`, and let `K` be the least positive integer such that
`(4/3)^K>=B`. Set

\[
                    M(c)=\max\{4,K+2\}.
\]

**HAND theorem.** If any finite strict private word realizes these four
coordinates, then a strict word with at most `M(c)` cells realizes the same
coordinates on one tuple. Its cost can be no greater than the supplied
word's cost. Thus its ordinary bank remains strictly below one.

The bound is deliberately conservative. In particular the arbitrarily weak
minimum-three examples have `M(c)=4`, and are consistent with this theorem.
The older unbounded-minimum family has rapidly increasing `B`; it is also
consistent. This is a one-witness bound, not a bound on all word lengths.

## Compact optimization at a supplied finite length

Put `q_i=1+2t_i(u_i-1)` and

\[
 R_i=1+\tfrac32(q_i-1)(u_i+1).
\]

Fix the supplied word's finite length `n`, ratio `q>1` and cost `U<B`.
In the closed semialgebraic set

\[
 u_i\ge1,\quad 1\le q_i\le(u_i+1)/2,\quad
 \prod u_i\le U,\quad \prod q_i=q,
\]

maximize `product R_i`. This is an ordinary compact finite-dimensional
optimization: each `u_i<=U`. There is no optimization over an infinite union.
The maximum is at least the supplied `r`.

Every maximizer spends the full cost `U`: increasing an active `u_i` with
`q_i>1` increases its `R_i`. A factor `q_i=1,u_i>1` wastes cost; moving its
cost into any active factor strictly increases the objective. Consequently
all inactive factors have `q_i=u_i=1` and can be deleted.

At most one active factor is unbalanced, `u_i>2q_i-1`. Indeed, hold the
`q_i` fixed and transfer logarithmic cost between two such factors. Each
term of the logarithmic objective is

\[
 \log[1+\tfrac32(q_i-1)+\tfrac32(q_i-1)e^{x_i}],\quad x_i=\log u_i,
\]

strictly convex in `x_i`. A two-sided interior cost transfer cannot be a
local maximum. Every other active factor is balanced, `q_i=(u_i+1)/2`.

## At most two balanced strengths, with the weaker one occurring once

For balanced factors define

\[
 b(x)=\log[(e^x+1)/2],\qquad
 d(x)=\log[(3e^{2x}+1)/4],\qquad x>0.
\]

Hold the possible unbalanced factor fixed. Among the balanced variables,
both `sum x_i` and `sum b(x_i)` are fixed. If they have at least two distinct
strengths, these two constraint gradients are independent, since

\[
 b'(x)=u/(u+1),\quad d'(x)=6u^2/(3u^2+1),\quad u=e^x.
\]

Lagrange multipliers give `d'(x_i)=lambda+mu b'(x_i)`. As a function of
`a=b'(x) in (1/2,1)`, the left side is

\[
 J(a)=6a^2/(4a^2-2a+1).
\]

It is strictly concave on this interval. To check the sign without a
numerical plot, its first derivative expressed in `u` is

\[
 h(u)=\frac{12u(u+1)^2}{(3u^2+1)^2},\qquad
 h'(u)=\frac{-12(u+1)(3u^3+9u^2-3u-1)}{(3u^2+1)^3}<0
\]

for `u>1`. A strictly concave graph meets a line in at most two points.
Thus there are at most two distinct balanced strengths.

If they are `w<u`, the weaker one cannot occur twice. The secant slope
`mu` lies strictly between `J'(b'(w))` and `J'(b'(u))`. Therefore
`d''-mu b''` is positive at `w`. A tangent vector adding to one repeated
`log w` and subtracting from another preserves both constraints to first
order, and has positive second variation of the Lagrangian. The gradients
are independent, so the constraint set is a smooth local manifold and this
contradicts the second-order necessary condition for a maximum.

Accordingly the balanced part is either a single repeated strength, or
one weaker factor and a repeated stronger strength. If fewer than three
balanced factors exist, the eventual count is already at most three.

## Three identical weak balanced cells cannot occur at a maximizer

For three balanced factors of the same strength `u`, put

\[
 q_*=(u+1)^3/8,\quad r_*=(3u^2+1)^3/64,\quad U_*=u^3.
\]

A single factor of cost `U_*` and ratio `q_*` is feasible:

\[
 (U_*+1)/2-q_*=3(u-1)^2(u+1)/8>0.
\]

Its resulting triple ratio is `1+(3/2)(q_*-1)(U_*+1)`. The exact identity

\[
 1+\tfrac32(q_*-1)(U_*+1)-r_*
 =\frac{3(u-1)^3(u+1)^2(7-5u)}{64}>0
\]

holds for `1<u<=4/3<7/5`. Replacing those three factors by this one preserves
their cost and pair ratio and strictly increases the triple objective.
Two vacant identity positions keep the construction within the original
fixed `n`-factor optimization. This contradicts maximality.

Thus, if the repeated balanced strength is at most `4/3`, it occurs at
most twice. Including the possible weaker balanced factor and the possible
unbalanced factor gives at most four active factors. If the repeated strength
is larger than `4/3`, its multiplicity is bounded by the cost:
`(4/3)^k < U < B <= (4/3)^K`, so `k<K`. Adding the same two exceptional
factors is safely covered by `M(c)` above. The all-equal balanced case uses
the same triple replacement or the same cost bound and requires no
Lagrange-multiplier regularity assumption.

We have obtained a maximizer with at most `M(c)` active factors and ratio
`r_max>=r`, without assuming the supplied length was bounded.

## Returning exactly the requested ratio, not just a larger one

For every word, `r>=f(q)=3q^2-3q+1`, as proved in the two-cell note.
Starting at the bounded maximizer, decrease its possible unbalanced `u_i`
to `2q_i-1`, keeping its `q_i` fixed. Cost and triple ratio decrease
continuously. All factors are now balanced.

Choose a factor of largest `q_i`. Merge each other factor into it by
continuously increasing the larger factor's ratio and decreasing the other
to one, keeping their product `P` fixed. Let `s` be their ratio sum; it
increases toward `P+1`. Their balanced cost is `4P+1-2s`, and their triple
ratio is

\[
 f(P)+3(P+1-s)(2P-s).
\]

Both decrease during this merge. At a ratio of one, delete that identity
factor. This gives a continuous path of kernels, each with at most `M(c)`
physical active cells and cost at most `U`, ending at the single balanced
factor with ratio `q` and triple ratio `f(q)`. The intermediate value theorem
produces exactly the supplied `r` between `f(q)` and `r_max`.

All retained factors have `u_i>1` and `0<t_i<=1/4`; identities fold into
ordinary passages. Set `A'=c product u_i <= cU<1` and use the strict
telescoping ordinary-passage factorization from the two-cell note. This
restores a strict shared physical tuple and proves the theorem.

## Recognition consequence and verification boundary

For exact real-algebraic input on this interface, compute `K` by exact
comparisons of rational powers with `1/c`, then decide one finite real-closed
field formula with `M(c)` possibly inactive cells:

\[
 u_i\ge1,\quad 1\le q_i\le(u_i+1)/2,\quad
 \prod u_i<1/c,\quad \prod q_i=q,\quad
 \prod[1+\tfrac32(q_i-1)(u_i+1)]=r.
\]

Inactive cells are absorbed into ordinary passages. A sampled solution
gives `t_i=(q_i-1)/(2(u_i-1))` for each active cell; the same direct four-
coordinate check used by the two-cell solver certifies its reconstructed
tuple. Real-algebraic sampling exists whenever this algebraic formula has
a real solution. Invalid coordinates and the ordinary zero-cell case are
handled before this formula.

This is a terminating mathematical recognition algorithm for this private
paired face, conditional only on the HAND proof above, not a claim that a
large hosted elimination has completed. The exact two-cell fast path is
already implemented and passed its 11 controls. Wolfram additionally checked
the derivative and triple-improvement identities exactly, the two necessary
signs by quantified real elimination, and the earlier failed middle-cost
trial formulas. Those failures are retained, not used as evidence of gain.
The exact actual results and authenticated admission/finite-code source
supplement are encrypted in `[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`.
`VerifyCap3FaceWordBoundAlgebra.wl`
contains the final exact symbolic and quantified checks.

`Cap3FaceWordBound.wl` now implements the exact bound, finite-formula builder
and all-length consumer, reusing the existing two-cell fast path and direct
physical-word verifier. A supplied seed is only a directly checked positive
certificate. Without one, exact elimination is used. A caller's timeout is
UNKNOWN/Failure, never NO. Every all-length result exposes HAND_THEOREM as
its bound evidence and keeps GeneralG3Closed false.

Actual hosted controls passed: the weak-three example's bound four, its
three-cell seed's direct four-coordinate check and padded finite formula,
the exact power control c=1/2 giving K=3/bound five, the ordinary fast path,
and a simple all-length exclusion via the finite formula. Encrypted receipt
`[encrypted runtime receipt retained privately]`; reproducible authored controls are in
`VerifyCap3FaceWordBound.wl`. No hard unseeded three-cell elimination was
claimed completed. The theorem's general completeness rests on the HAND
optimizer/count/path proof, not those specified numerical cases.

Remaining work: independent mathematical review of that argument; difficult
practical elimination; native source/current-root/copy/calendar reflection
and the existing writer hold; extension beyond this face and cap. None
supplies unrestricted original G3 NO termination.

# Why the private face bound does not yet give the original input bound

Authored 2026-10-21, additive scope clarification to the immutable
`G3-CAP3-FACE-ALL-LENGTH-BOUND.md`. The HAND theorem and its proof are unchanged.

In a larger recognition problem, `c` can be an existential INTERNAL kernel
coordinate rather than a supplied observation. The proved bound
`M(c)=max(4,K+2)`, with `(4/3)^K>=1/c`, then varies as `c` tends to zero.
It does not supply a target-derived positive lower bound on that coordinate,
or a bound uniform over every fitting chart bank.

choice/lower-bound supplier would be needed before this becomes an original
input bound `H(p)`. It suffices to bound the internal `c` values for ONE
fitting bank, not all banks. Source reconstruction and finite-code admission
alone do not provide this implication. Higher caps and the off-face paired
word problem retain additional independent gaps.
